papers.title: Jacobian: Composable mathematics for agent-driven research experiments
papers.name: Jacobian

zh.problem: 让科学智能体复用可检查的数学操作。
zh.method: 提供带类型与条件约束的数学原语，供智能体搜索、组合和执行。
zh.evaluation: 官方代码工具；这里没有单独的论文实验结果。

en.problem: Make mathematical operations reusable and checkable for research agents.
en.method: Provides typed mathematical primitives with explicit conditions that agents can find, compose and execute.
en.evaluation: An official software project; this entry does not provide a separate paper evaluation.

papers.sourceTitle: Jacobian: Composable mathematics for agent-driven research experiments

zh: Jacobian 把可检查的数学操作做成工具；使用时要关注适用条件和执行结果。
en: Jacobian packages checkable mathematical operations; their preconditions and execution results matter.

papers.title: Agon: An Autonomous Large-Scale Omnidisciplinary Research System Built on Prompt Economy
papers.name: Agon

zh.problem: 规模化开展研究后，如何区分产物数量和结论质量？
zh.method: 以精简提示和并行研究循环组织任务，将可执行检查与科学判断分开。
zh.evaluation: 报告跨领域的 444 轮运行，并分析哪些失败仍需人类判断。

en.problem: How can scalable research distinguish output volume from the quality of its claims?
en.method: Orchestrates parallel research loops using compact prompts and separates executable checks from scientific judgment.
en.evaluation: Reports 444 cross-domain iterations and analyzes failures that still require human judgment.

papers.sourceTitle: Agon: An Autonomous Large-Scale Omnidisciplinary Research System Built on Prompt Economy

zh: 并行开展更多研究能提高产量，但“程序跑通”仍不能保证论文论断成立。
en: Parallel research increases throughput; successful execution alone does not establish a scientific claim.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 顺着选题、想法、方案、实验、论文五个阶段看。每阶段有自己的审核循环，文献检索为多个阶段提供上下文。
figures.en: Follow topic selection through ideas, proposals, experiments and papers. Each stage has its own review loop, with literature context reused across stages.

papers.title: What's Missing in Autonomous Research? A Systematization of Systems, Benchmarks, and Verification
papers.name: Autonomous Research: What's Missing?

zh.problem: 现有自主研究系统到底验证了什么？
zh.method: 按系统、任务、产物和验证方式组织文献，区分生成研究材料与支撑科学结论。
zh.evaluation: 系统化综述；不是一个新智能体的性能报告。

en.problem: What do autonomous research systems actually verify?
en.method: Organizes systems, tasks, artifacts and verification practices, distinguishing generated research artifacts from supported claims.
en.evaluation: A systematization of prior work, rather than a performance report for a new agent.

papers.sourceTitle: What's Missing in Autonomous Research? A Systematization of Systems, Benchmarks, and Verification

zh: 读这篇综述时，可以把“能产出什么”和“能证明什么”分开比较。
en: Use this survey to compare output capabilities separately from the evidence supporting them.

figures.label: Seven-axis framework
figures.zh: 这张图用七个维度描述研究系统。重点看验证机制能否阻止不可靠结果，以及证据实际覆盖了哪些领域。
figures.en: The seven axes describe different parts of a research system. Focus on what verification can block and which disciplines actually have supporting evidence.

papers.title: Why LLMs Aren't Scientists Yet: Lessons from Four Autonomous Research Attempts
papers.name: Why LLMs Aren't Scientists Yet

zh.problem: 端到端研究为何仍会在实现和判断环节失效？
zh.method: 回顾多智能体研究尝试，分析记忆丢失、实现偏移与研究判断问题。
zh.evaluation: 四个机器学习研究案例；结论是案例观察，不是通用能力排名。

en.problem: Why does end-to-end research still fail at implementation and judgment?
en.method: Examines multi-agent research attempts for memory loss, implementation drift and weak research judgment.
en.evaluation: Four machine-learning research cases; the conclusions are case observations, not a general capability ranking.

papers.sourceTitle: Why LLMs Aren't Scientists Yet: Lessons from Four Autonomous Research Attempts

zh: 四次研究尝试中三次未能完成实现或有效评价；成功运行时，也要检查代码是否仍在检验原本的想法。
en: Three of four attempts failed during implementation or evaluation; even successful runs need checks that the code tests the intended idea.

figures.label: Figure 3
figures.zh: 筛选从一百多篇候选论文收缩到四个研究尝试，最终仅一个完成。图中每次收缩都对应现实执行限制。
figures.en: The funnel narrows a large candidate pool to four research attempts and one completed project. Each narrowing exposes a practical execution constraint.

papers.title: Kosmos: An AI Scientist for Autonomous Discovery
papers.name: Kosmos

zh.problem: 如何让长时间的数据分析和文献检索共同推进一个科学问题？
zh.method: 并行安排分析和检索智能体，用结构化世界模型共享中间发现并生成可追溯报告。
zh.evaluation: 展示代谢组、材料、神经科学和遗传学等七项发现，并报告科学家评估。

en.problem: How can prolonged data analysis and literature search advance one scientific question together?
en.method: Runs analysis and search agents in parallel, sharing intermediate findings through a structured world model and producing traceable reports.
en.evaluation: Presents seven discoveries across areas including metabolomics, materials, neuroscience and genetics, alongside scientist assessments.

papers.sourceTitle: Kosmos: An AI Scientist for Autonomous Discovery

institutions: Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard

zh: Kosmos 的关键是让长期研究保持上下文，并把报告中的论断追溯到具体分析。
en: Kosmos keeps extended research coherent and connects report claims to the analyses behind them.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 先看中间的共享世界模型：它把检索与数据分析连接起来。后面的准确性评估分别检查分析、文献和解释，不能混成一种正确率。
figures.en: Start with the shared world model linking search and analysis. The accuracy panel distinguishes data analysis, literature claims and interpretation; these are different kinds of evidence.

papers.title: Autonomous Agents for Scientific Discovery: Orchestrating Scientists, Language, Code, and Physics
papers.name: Orchestrating Scientists, Language, Code & Physics

zh.problem: 科学家的判断、语言推理、代码和物理模型如何协作？
zh.method: 讨论将这些能力编排到科学发现流程中的架构与挑战。
zh.evaluation: 观点与框架讨论；不应解读成一个统一系统已完成全部验证。

en.problem: How should scientists, language reasoning, code and physical models work together?
en.method: Discusses architectures and challenges for coordinating these capabilities across scientific discovery.
en.evaluation: A perspective and framework discussion; it does not establish full validation of one unified system.

papers.sourceTitle: Autonomous Agents for Scientific Discovery: Orchestrating Scientists, Language, Code, and Physics

zh: 这篇文章适合用来设计研究流程；它提出的是框架，而不是一个系统的统一成绩单。
en: This paper helps structure a research workflow; its framework is not a single system's performance score.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 从提出可检验问题，到设计并执行实验，再到分析结果与修正问题。图中回路强调实验结果需要改变下一步决策。
figures.en: Follow the path from a testable question to experiments and revision. The feedback loop matters because results should change the next research decision.

papers.title: From AI for Science to Agentic Science: A Survey on Autonomous Scientific Discovery
papers.name: From AI for Science to Agentic Science

zh.problem: 科学 AI 怎样从单任务模型走向能规划和行动的系统？
zh.method: 梳理不同学科的智能体工作，比较任务流程、自主程度和工具使用。
zh.evaluation: 综述生命、化学与物理科学等研究方向，不提供统一排行榜。

en.problem: How is scientific AI moving from task-specific models to systems that plan and act?
en.method: Surveys scientific agents across disciplines, comparing workflows, autonomy and tool use.
en.evaluation: A survey spanning life, chemical and physical sciences, without a unified performance leaderboard.

papers.sourceTitle: From AI for Science to Agentic Science: A Survey on Autonomous Scientific Discovery

zh: 比较科学智能体时，实际自主完成了哪些研究步骤，比“用了几个智能体”更有意义。
en: Compare the research steps completed autonomously, rather than just counting agents.

figures.label: Figure 3
figures.zh: 科学家给出方向，智能体在发现循环里行动。沿循环检查规划、工具、记忆、协作与反馈分别由谁负责。
figures.en: A scientist supplies direction while an agent runs the discovery loop. Trace who handles planning, tools, memory, collaboration and feedback.

papers.title: The AI Scientist-v2: Workshop-Level Automated Scientific Discovery via Agentic Tree Search
papers.name: The AI Scientist-v2

zh.problem: 能否减少人工模板，自动探索机器学习研究思路？
zh.method: 通过渐进式树搜索安排实验，并用视觉语言反馈检查图表，串联实验和论文写作。
zh.evaluation: 报告三个研讨会投稿实验，其中一个达到评审接受阈值；这不等于普遍具备科学发现能力。

en.problem: Can machine-learning research be explored with less dependence on human-written templates?
en.method: Uses progressive tree search for experiments and vision-language feedback for figures, connecting experimentation to paper writing.
en.evaluation: Reports three workshop submission experiments, one reaching the review acceptance threshold; this is not evidence of general scientific discovery capability.

papers.sourceTitle: The AI Scientist-v2: Workshop-Level Automated Scientific Discovery via Agentic Tree Search

zh: v2 把实验探索组织成树，减少对人工实验模板的依赖；论文质量仍需独立评审。
en: Version 2 uses tree search to reduce template dependence; paper quality still needs independent review.

figures.label: Figure 2
figures.zh: 每个节点对应一个代码或实验版本。出错的节点走修复分支，可运行的节点继续改进；树结构允许保留不同探索方向。
figures.en: Each node is a code or experiment variant. Failed nodes trigger repairs; runnable nodes support further experiments. The tree preserves alternative research directions.

papers.title: AgentRxiv: Towards Collaborative Autonomous Research
papers.name: AgentRxiv

zh.problem: 不同智能体实验室能否积累并复用先前研究？
zh.method: 把生成的研究存入共享预印本文库，让后续研究检索并扩展已有结果。
zh.evaluation: 在 MATH-500 等推理研究任务中测试知识共享与累积改进。

en.problem: Can separate agent laboratories accumulate and reuse previous research?
en.method: Stores generated research in a shared preprint repository so later work can retrieve and extend earlier results.
en.evaluation: Tests shared research and cumulative improvement on reasoning research tasks including MATH-500.

papers.sourceTitle: AgentRxiv: Towards Collaborative Autonomous Research

zh: 共享研究库让后续实验接续前人结果，也使入库内容的质量控制更重要。
en: A shared research repository lets later runs build on prior work, making archive quality control important.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 多个实验室把论文放进共享库，其他实验室再检索这些结果。重点看知识怎样跨研究运行传播，而不只是单次对话中的记忆。
figures.en: Laboratories publish to a shared repository and retrieve each other's findings. Look for knowledge transfer across separate runs, beyond one conversation's memory.

papers.title: Towards an AI co-scientist
papers.name: AI Co-Scientist

zh.problem: 如何从一个研究目标形成更值得实验的生物医学假设？
zh.method: 多个智能体生成、批评和修订假设，通过竞争式评估逐步筛选研究提案。
zh.evaluation: 研究包含药物重定位等生物医学案例及实验检验；具体结论限于相应案例。

en.problem: How can a research goal become a biomedical hypothesis worth testing?
en.method: Agents generate, criticize and revise hypotheses, using tournament-style assessment to select proposals.
en.evaluation: Includes biomedical cases such as drug repurposing and experimental tests; findings are specific to those cases.

papers.sourceTitle: Towards an AI co-scientist

zh: 假设的内部排名适合帮助筛选，但不能代替对候选结论的实验检验。
en: Internal hypothesis rankings help prioritize work but do not replace experimental validation.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 生成、评审、排序和改进假设形成循环。候选之间的比较指导继续探索；实验验证才把有说服力的假设连接到实际证据。
figures.en: Hypothesis generation, review, ranking and refinement form a loop. Candidate comparisons guide exploration; experiments connect persuasive hypotheses to empirical evidence.

papers.title: Agent Laboratory: Using LLM Agents as Research Assistants
papers.name: Agent Laboratory

zh.problem: 如何把研究者的初始想法转化成实验和报告？
zh.method: 将文献整理、实验执行和论文写作交给不同智能体，在阶段间接受用户反馈。
zh.evaluation: 使用机器学习实验与研究者反馈评估流程质量和实用性。

en.problem: How can a researcher's initial idea become experiments and a report?
en.method: Assigns literature review, experiment execution and writing to agents, incorporating user feedback between stages.
en.evaluation: Evaluates workflow quality and usefulness through machine-learning experiments and researcher feedback.

papers.sourceTitle: Agent Laboratory: Using LLM Agents as Research Assistants

zh: 这更像一个可协作的研究工作台：研究方向和结果判断仍需要研究者参与。
en: Treat it as a collaborative research workbench, with researchers involved in direction and judgment.

figures.label: Figure 2
figures.zh: 文献整理、实验、写报告分成三个阶段。图中专门的求解器负责代码和论文，人类可以在关键阶段补充指导。
figures.en: The workflow separates literature review, experimentation and reporting. Specialized solvers handle code and manuscripts, with opportunities for human guidance.

papers.title: MLR-Copilot: Autonomous Machine Learning Research based on Large Language Models Agents
papers.name: MLR-Copilot

zh.problem: 机器学习研究想法如何更可靠地落到可运行实验？
zh.method: 结合想法生成、原型代码检索、执行调试与人工反馈。
zh.evaluation: 在五项机器学习研究任务上评估实验生成能力。

en.problem: How can machine-learning ideas be translated into executable experiments?
en.method: Combines idea generation, retrieval of prototype code, execution, debugging and human feedback.
en.evaluation: Evaluates experiment-generation capabilities on five machine-learning research tasks.

papers.sourceTitle: MLR-Copilot: Autonomous Machine Learning Research based on Large Language Models Agents

zh: 评价研究代理时，需要同时检查想法质量、实验设计和可执行性。
en: Assess idea quality, experimental design and executability together.

figures.label: Figure 2
figures.zh: IdeaAgent 把论文变成新假设与实验计划；ExperimentAgent 负责实现和执行。两段之间的交接决定想法是否真的被测试。
figures.en: IdeaAgent turns papers into hypotheses and experiment plans; ExperimentAgent implements and runs them. Their handoff determines whether the intended idea is actually tested.

tables.label: Table 3
tables.zh: 比较相同任务上的相对改进；N/A 表示执行失败，不能忽略这些失败只比较成功结果。
tables.en: Compare improvements within the same task. N/A marks execution failures, which should not disappear from the comparison.

papers.title: The AI Scientist: Towards Fully Automated Open-Ended Scientific Discovery
papers.name: The AI Scientist

zh.problem: 从研究想法到实验、图表和论文，哪些环节能被串联自动化？
zh.method: 使用语言模型迭代生成想法、改代码、运行实验、撰写论文并给出自动评审。
zh.evaluation: 在扩散模型、Transformer 与学习动力学方向展示流程；自动评审不是科学正确性的保证。

en.problem: Which steps from an idea to experiments, figures and a paper can be automated together?
en.method: Uses language models to iterate on ideas, modify code, run experiments, write papers and produce automated reviews.
en.evaluation: Demonstrates workflows in diffusion models, Transformers and learning dynamics; automated review does not guarantee scientific correctness.

papers.sourceTitle: The AI Scientist: Towards Fully Automated Open-Ended Scientific Discovery

zh: 把研究步骤串起来是主要贡献；自动写出论文不等于已经产生可靠的新发现。
en: The contribution is an integrated research pipeline; a generated paper is not automatically a reliable discovery.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 从产生想法、修改代码、运行实验到写论文，形成端到端链条。注意实验从预设代码模板出发，自动评审也只是链条的一部分。
figures.en: Trace ideas through code edits, experiments and manuscript writing. Experiments begin from supplied templates, and automated reviewing is another component of the pipeline.

tables.label: Table 1

grid.text: Human (NeurIPS)11 1 Numbers are calculated based of the NeurIPS consistency experiment .

tables.zh: 这里评估的是自动审稿与已有决定的一致性，不是代理独立发现了多少新知识。
tables.en: This evaluates automated reviewing against existing decisions, not how many new discoveries the agent made.

papers.title: AutoSurvey: Large Language Models Can Automatically Write Surveys
papers.name: AutoSurvey

zh.problem: 如何在大量文献中快速组织一篇连贯的综述？
zh.method: 检索相关论文并形成提纲，平行撰写子章节，再整合与修订。
zh.evaluation: 论文评估综述生成质量和引用表现；产物是文献综述。

en.problem: How can a coherent survey be organized from a large literature collection?
en.method: Retrieves papers, builds an outline, drafts subsections in parallel, then integrates and revises them.
en.evaluation: Evaluates survey-generation quality and citation performance; the output is a literature survey.

papers.sourceTitle: AutoSurvey: Large Language Models Can Automatically Write Surveys

zh: 自动综述把大任务拆成检索和分节写作；引用准确性与覆盖面需要单独检查。
en: Survey automation decomposes retrieval and writing; citation accuracy and coverage need separate checks.

figures.label: Figure 2
figures.zh: 先检索资料并拟定提纲，再让不同模块撰写小节，最后整合与评估。检查每节是否有证据，比只看文章是否完整更重要。
figures.en: Retrieval informs an outline, specialized modules draft sections, and later stages integrate and evaluate them. Check section-level evidence, not just completeness.

tables.label: Table 7
tables.zh: 这张表提供成本信息。理解效率时还要结合综述覆盖面与引用质量。
tables.en: These are cost measurements; interpret efficiency alongside survey coverage and citation quality.

papers.title: PaperQA: Retrieval-augmented generative agent for scientific research
papers.name: PaperQA

zh.problem: 科学问答怎样给出能回溯到原文的证据？
zh.method: 检索论文全文、筛选相关段落，再结合证据生成带引用的回答。
zh.evaluation: 使用 LitQA 等文献问答任务，并与人类回答进行比较。

en.problem: How can scientific question answering provide evidence traceable to source texts?
en.method: Retrieves paper text, selects relevant passages and synthesizes answers with citations.
en.evaluation: Uses literature question-answering tasks including LitQA and comparisons with human answers.

papers.sourceTitle: PaperQA: Retrieval-Augmented Generative Agent for Scientific Research

zh: PaperQA 的价值在“找到并使用证据”；仍要检查引用是否真的支持回答。
en: PaperQA finds and uses evidence; check that each cited passage supports the answer.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 问题先触发检索，再从全文提取相关证据，最后生成带引用的回答。关键是回答建立在找到的证据片段上。
figures.en: A question triggers search, evidence extraction from full texts, and a cited answer. The answer should be grounded in the retrieved passages.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.zh: 在同一 LitQA 设置下比较检索问答方法，注意论文区分的回答正确性与拒答行为。
tables.en: Compare methods under the same LitQA setup, including correctness and abstention behavior.

papers.title: Scientific discovery in the age of artificial intelligence
papers.name: Scientific Discovery in the Age of AI

zh.problem: AI 正在怎样改变科学研究的方法与组织方式？
zh.method: 从数据、模型和科学发现流程梳理人工智能的作用与局限。
zh.evaluation: 领域综述；不对应一个可直接运行的统一科学智能体。

en.problem: How is AI changing the methods and organization of scientific research?
en.method: Reviews AI's role and limitations across data, models and scientific discovery workflows.
en.evaluation: A field review, rather than a single executable scientific-agent system.

papers.sourceTitle: Scientific discovery in the age of artificial intelligence

en: Use it to map AI for Science; results across disciplines do not share one universal score.

figures.label: Fig. 1
figures.zh: 这张总览把数据、模型和科学工作连接起来。阅读时区分用于理解数据的模型、生成候选的方法和验证候选的实验。
figures.en: The overview connects scientific data, models and research activities. Distinguish data understanding, candidate generation and the experiments validating candidates.

papers.title: HypoForge: A Self-Improving Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Hypothesis Generation and Testing via Scientific Skill Learning
papers.name: HypoForge

zh.problem: 智能体能否从验证反馈中学会提出更好的假设？
zh.method: 生成器与判别器对抗协作，把执行结果转成后续可复用的假设检验技能。
zh.evaluation: 在科学假设任务中评估；改进主要发生在技能和推理流程层。

en.problem: Can agents learn to propose better hypotheses from verification feedback?
en.method: A generator and discriminator work adversarially, turning execution results into reusable hypothesis-testing skills.
en.evaluation: Evaluated on scientific hypothesis tasks; improvement primarily concerns skills and reasoning workflows.

papers.sourceTitle: HypoForge: A Self-Improving Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Hypothesis Generation and Testing via Scientific Skill Learning

zh: 它改进的是可复用的科研技能，而不是在每轮都微调基础模型。
en: It improves reusable research skills without fine-tuning the foundation model each round.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 产生假设与检验假设使用不同的学习信号：前者靠比较和批评，后者靠执行结果。可复用技能把这些反馈留下来。
figures.en: Hypothesis generation learns from comparative critique; hypothesis testing learns from execution outcomes. Reusable skills preserve feedback from both stages.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.zh: 比较假设生成的不同评价维度，不能把语言模型给分直接当作假设已被实验验证。
tables.en: Compare hypothesis-generation criteria without treating judge scores as experimental confirmation.

papers.title: Meta$^n$: Recursive Self-Improvement through Emergent Depth
papers.name: Metaⁿ

zh.problem: 优化器能否继续优化帮助自己求解的程序？
zh.method: 递归叠加求解辅助程序与元优化层，用统一操作探索不同深度的优化结构。
zh.evaluation: 覆盖八类任务，包括数学与符号回归；部分任务缺少独立留出集，不能据此推断通用 RSI。

en.problem: Can an optimizer improve the programs that help it solve problems?
en.method: Recursively adds solver helpers and meta-optimization layers, exploring optimization depth with a shared operation.
en.evaluation: Covers eight task families, including mathematics and symbolic regression; some lack held-out splits, limiting claims about general RSI.

papers.sourceTitle: Meta$^n$: Recursive Self-Improvement through Emergent Depth

zh: 递归自我改进需要明确“改进哪一层”，并用独立任务检验收益。
en: Recursive improvement requires specifying the layer being changed and testing gains independently.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 左侧把同一个元操作逐层套到求解器上，右侧展示搜索进展。层数更深意味着可修改更高层的改进流程。
figures.en: The left recursively wraps a solver with the same meta-operation; the right shows search progress. Added depth makes higher-level improvement processes editable.

tables.label: Table 1
tables.zh: 表中不同任务使用各自指标；跨列数值不能直接相加，需在同任务中比较方法。
tables.en: Tasks use different metrics. Compare methods within each task rather than adding values across columns.

papers.title: SciToolAgent-Evo: An Ontology-Aware Self-Evolving Agent for Open-World Scientific Tool Acquisition
papers.name: SciToolAgent-Evo

zh.problem: 科学工具不断变化时，智能体如何扩充并保留能力？
zh.method: 把工具组织成图谱，积累技能与经验，并用在线选择机制决定何时获取新工具。
zh.evaluation: 在包含 900 个任务的 OpenSciToolBench 中检验动态工具使用。

en.problem: How can an agent expand and retain capabilities as scientific tools change?
en.method: Organizes tools in a graph, retains skills and experience, and uses an online selection mechanism to acquire tools.
en.evaluation: Tests dynamic tool use on the 900-task OpenSciToolBench.

papers.sourceTitle: SciToolAgent-Evo: An Ontology-Aware Self-Evolving Agent for Open-World Scientific Tool Acquisition

institutions: ZJU-Hangzhou Global Scientific and Technological Innovation Center
Zhejiang University–University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign Institute

zh: 这里的持续学习主要体现在技能与知识积累，工具选择也需要成本与效果的反馈。
en: Continual learning happens through accumulated skills and knowledge, with feedback on tool effectiveness and cost.

figures.label: Figure 2
figures.zh: 左侧从成功与失败轨迹中提炼知识，右侧按任务检索技能、选择工具并更新知识。注意哪些经验真正进入下一轮决策。
figures.en: The left distills knowledge from contrasting trajectories. The right retrieves skills, selects tools and updates knowledge. Trace which experiences affect later decisions.

tables.label: Table 1
tables.zh: 先固定基础模型，再比较工具使用方法；表中均值与波动反映重复运行的差异。
tables.en: Hold the backbone fixed when comparing tool-use methods; means and variability reflect repeated runs.

papers.title: Evidence-Informed LLM Beliefs for Continual Scientific Discovery
papers.name: Evidence-Informed Beliefs

zh.problem: 新证据能否改变智能体后续探索的方向？
zh.method: 检索先前发现，在上下文中更新信念，并兼顾信息增益与探索多样性。
zh.evaluation: 在五个领域评估发现过程；这是证据驱动的上下文更新。

en.problem: Can new evidence change the direction of an agent's later exploration?
en.method: Retrieves earlier discoveries to update contextual beliefs while balancing informative and diverse exploration.
en.evaluation: Evaluates discovery processes in five domains; adaptation comes from evidence-informed contextual updates.

papers.sourceTitle: Evidence-Informed LLM Beliefs for Continual Scientific Discovery

zh: 纳入既往发现后，论文识别出约 37.5% 的静态“惊讶”已可被已有证据解释，减少重复发现的奖励。
en: After incorporating earlier findings, about 37.5% of static surprises were explainable by existing evidence, reducing rewards for rediscovery.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 比较固定先验与纳入既往证据后的信念。同一个结果可能在第一次很意外，积累相关证据后就不再意外。
figures.en: Compare fixed priors with beliefs informed by earlier evidence. A result surprising at first may become expected after related findings accumulate.

papers.title: MLEvolve: A Self-Evolving Framework for Automated Machine Learning Algorithm Discovery
papers.name: MLEvolve

zh.problem: 怎样避免机器学习智能体反复尝试相同的低效方案？
zh.method: 用渐进式图搜索联系不同实验分支，并用回顾记忆指导下一轮策略。
zh.evaluation: 在 MLE-bench 与数学优化任务中评估。

en.problem: How can machine-learning agents avoid repeating ineffective experiments?
en.method: Links experimental branches through progressive graph search and uses retrospective memory to guide future strategies.
en.evaluation: Evaluated on MLE-bench and mathematical optimization tasks.

papers.sourceTitle: MLEvolve: A Self-Evolving Framework for Automated Machine Learning Algorithm Discovery

zh: 长期优化需要保留有效经验，并让不同搜索分支互相借鉴。
en: Long-horizon optimization benefits from retained experience and information sharing across search branches.

figures.label: Figure 2
figures.zh: 图把跨分支的信息共享、回顾性记忆和分层规划分开。关注一次失败如何改变其他分支的实验选择。
figures.en: The diagram separates cross-branch sharing, retrospective memory and hierarchical planning. Follow how one failed attempt can inform another branch.

tables.label: Table 1
tables.zh: 比较完整 MLE-Bench 上的奖牌率，同时检查有效提交率，避免只看成功任务。
tables.en: Read medal rates on the full MLE-Bench together with valid-submission rates.

papers.title: EvoMaster: A Foundational Evolving Agent Framework for Agentic Science at Scale
papers.name: EvoMaster

zh.problem: 如何让跨多轮研究积累的经验影响后续执行？
zh.method: 把执行、探索与演化组织成持续循环，保留可支持下一轮决策的证据。
zh.evaluation: 报告十个混合科学与计算基准上的结果。

en.problem: How can experience accumulated across research iterations influence later execution?
en.method: Connects execution, exploration and evolution in persistent loops, retaining evidence for later decisions.
en.evaluation: Reports results across ten mixed scientific and computational benchmarks.

papers.sourceTitle: EvoMaster: A Foundational Evolving Agent Framework for Agentic Science at Scale

zh: 区分单次执行、实验搜索和跨任务学习，才能判断系统是否真的在持续进步。
en: Separate execution, experiment search and cross-task learning when judging continued improvement.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 最内层执行动作，中间层比较实验，最外层跨研究积累并提炼经验。三层的更新对象和反馈频率不同。
figures.en: The inner loop executes actions, the middle compares experiments, and the outer distills experience across studies. Each loop updates something different.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.zh: 同一基础模型下比较不同系统。各基准定义的分数不同，应分别理解。
tables.en: Compare systems sharing a backbone, while keeping each benchmark's scoring definition separate.

papers.title: CORAL: Towards Autonomous Multi-Agent Evolution for Open-Ended Discovery
papers.name: CORAL

zh.problem: 并行科研智能体如何长期共享有用的发现？
zh.method: 让持续运行的智能体共享知识与记忆，在不同探索路径之间交换经验。
zh.evaluation: 在数学、算法与优化问题中检验协作效果。

en.problem: How can parallel research agents share useful findings over time?
en.method: Persistent agents share knowledge and memory, exchanging experience across exploration paths.
en.evaluation: Evaluates collaboration on mathematics, algorithmic and optimization problems.

papers.sourceTitle: CORAL: Towards Autonomous Multi-Agent Evolution for Open-Ended Discovery

institutions: Singapore-MIT Alliance for Research and Technology

zh: 并行搜索的收益依赖可验证的反馈，以及其他智能体能复用的经验记录。
en: Parallel search gains depend on verifiable feedback and experience that other agents can reuse.

figures.label: Figure 2
figures.zh: 独立工作区里的智能体通过共享中心保存尝试、笔记和技能。周期性反思帮助它们整理成果，调整下一步搜索。
figures.en: Agents work independently but share attempts, notes and skills through a hub. Periodic reflection consolidates findings and redirects search.

tables.label: Table 3
tables.zh: 这是消融实验：移除知识积累或协作组件后，再看分数变化，用来判断改进来自哪里。
tables.en: This ablation removes knowledge or collaboration components to test which mechanisms contribute to gains.

papers.title: Hyperagents
papers.name: Hyperagents

zh.problem: 智能体能否同时改进任务程序和自己的改进程序？
zh.method: 将任务智能体与元智能体实现为可编辑代码，允许修改求解流程及元级更新逻辑。
zh.evaluation: 在多个计算任务中测试，并研究元级经验跨领域转移。

en.problem: Can an agent improve both its task program and the program that improves it?
en.method: Represents task and meta-agents as editable programs, allowing changes to both solving and meta-level update logic.
en.evaluation: Tests multiple computational tasks and studies transfer of meta-level experience across domains.

papers.sourceTitle: Hyperagents

zh: 递归改进不只改答案或工具，也让产生下一次改进的程序接受检验和修改。
en: Recursive improvement also changes the program responsible for producing future improvements.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 任务代理解决问题，元代理修改任务代理；两者都在可编辑程序中。关键变化是“如何改进自己”的机制也可以改变。
figures.en: A task agent solves problems while a meta-agent modifies it. Both live in editable code, allowing the improvement procedure itself to change.

papers.title: EvoScientist: Towards Multi-Agent Evolving AI Scientists for End-to-End Scientific Discovery
papers.name: EvoScientist

zh.problem: 研究构思与实验经验如何共同积累？
zh.method: 研究员、工程师与演化管理者分工，把构思和实验经验保存为不同记忆。
zh.evaluation: 评估研究想法质量与代码执行表现；记忆更新不等于基础模型权重更新。

en.problem: How can research ideas and experimental experience accumulate together?
en.method: A researcher, engineer and evolution manager retain separate memories for ideation and experiments.
en.evaluation: Evaluates idea quality and code execution; memory updates are distinct from foundation-model weight updates.

papers.sourceTitle: EvoScientist: Towards Multi-Agent Evolving AI Scientists for End-to-End Scientific Discovery

zh: 想法记忆与实验记忆分开保存，有助于避免只复用结论却丢失实现经验。
en: Separate idea and experiment memories preserve both research reasoning and implementation experience.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 研究者代理负责想法，工程师代理负责实验，演化管理者把交互记录提炼成两种长期记忆，供后续研究检索。
figures.en: A researcher handles ideas, an engineer handles experiments, and an evolution manager distills two persistent memories for later retrieval.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.zh: 这张表使用人类专家评价想法，体现的是专家评分而非后续实验成功率。
tables.en: These are human expert ratings of ideas, not subsequent experimental success rates.

papers.title: S1-NexusAgent: a Self-Evolving Agent Framework for Multidisciplinary Scientific Research
papers.name: S1-NexusAgent

zh.problem: 复杂科学任务怎样在规划和实际执行之间保持连贯？
zh.method: 分层规划与代码执行形成双循环，结合工具调用与批评反馈蒸馏科学技能。
zh.evaluation: 在生物、化学和材料科学任务中评估。

en.problem: How can complex scientific tasks stay coherent from planning through execution?
en.method: Combines hierarchical planning and code execution with tool use and critique-based distillation of scientific skills.
en.evaluation: Evaluated on biology, chemistry and materials-science tasks.

papers.sourceTitle: S1-NexusAgent: a Self-Evolving Agent Framework for Multidisciplinary Scientific Research

institutions: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences

zh: 工具库变大后，重点是准确找到当前所需工具，而不是一次把所有工具都交给模型。
en: As tool libraries grow, selecting the relevant tools becomes more important than exposing every tool at once.

figures.label: Figure 2
figures.zh: 先按任务意图筛掉无关工具领域，再做细粒度匹配，把需要的工具按需放进上下文。
figures.en: Task intent first narrows tool domains; finer matching then brings relevant tools into context on demand.

tables.zh: 比较各类生物医学任务上的表现，留意不同任务对检索、工具和推理能力的要求。
tables.en: Compare biomedical task categories with their different retrieval, tool-use and reasoning demands.

papers.title: Learning to Discover at Test Time
papers.name: TTT-Discover

zh.problem: 能否针对一个困难测试问题，边求解边训练模型？
zh.method: 利用该问题的验证反馈进行测试时强化学习，目标是找到更好的单问题解。
zh.evaluation: 涉及数学、算法、计算内核与单细胞去噪；不是跨任务终身记忆评估。

en.problem: Can a model be trained while solving a difficult test-time problem?
en.method: Uses task verification feedback for test-time reinforcement learning to find a better solution to one problem.
en.evaluation: Covers mathematics, algorithms, kernels and single-cell denoising; it does not evaluate lifelong retention across tasks.

papers.sourceTitle: Learning to Discover at Test Time

zh: 这是针对当前问题的训练；它与只增加采样次数不同，也不直接证明跨问题泛化。
en: This is training on the current problem, beyond extra sampling; it does not by itself establish cross-problem generalization.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 模型在同一个测试问题上继续训练，奖励分布随更新变化。关注最优解是否提高，而不只是平均输出质量。
figures.en: The model keeps training on one test problem, changing its reward distribution. Track the best solution, not only average output quality.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.zh: 数学构造的目标有高低方向之分，应按具体问题比较最优可行解，并回到原文检查有效性条件。
tables.en: Respect each mathematical objective's direction and compare feasible solutions under the stated validity conditions.

papers.title: AlphaEvolve: A coding agent for scientific and algorithmic discovery
papers.name: AlphaEvolve

zh.problem: 语言模型提出的程序能否经执行筛选而持续改进？
zh.method: 让语言模型生成候选代码，以可计算目标评价，再进行进化式搜索。
zh.evaluation: 展示数学与计算基础设施优化；基础语言模型在搜索中保持固定。

en.problem: Can model-proposed programs improve through repeated execution and selection?
en.method: Language models propose code candidates that are scored by executable objectives and selected through evolutionary search.
en.evaluation: Demonstrates mathematical and computing-infrastructure optimization with fixed underlying language models.

papers.sourceTitle: AlphaEvolve: A coding agent for scientific and algorithmic discovery

zh: 可执行、可信的评分器是核心：搜索会不断追逐它定义的“更好”。
en: A trustworthy executable evaluator is central because search optimizes whatever that evaluator rewards.

figures.label: Figure 2
figures.zh: 提示采样器从程序库挑选参考，模型生成修改，评估器执行并打分，再把有价值的程序存回库。
figures.en: A prompt sampler selects reference programs, the model proposes edits, evaluators run and score them, and useful variants return to the archive.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.zh: 这里的秩对应矩阵乘法所需的标量乘法次数，越小越好；比较必须固定矩阵尺寸和运算条件。
tables.en: Rank counts scalar multiplications, so lower is better. Hold matrix dimensions and arithmetic conditions fixed.

papers.title: Darwin Godel Machine: Open-Ended Evolution of Self-Improving Agents
papers.name: Darwin Gödel Machine

zh.problem: 代码智能体能否修改自身实现以提升任务表现？
zh.method: 生成并评测自身代码的变体，用开放式档案保留有用的智能体分支。
zh.evaluation: 在软件工程和编程基准中测试；对科学实验室的适用性尚未由这些结果建立。

en.problem: Can a coding agent modify its own implementation to improve task performance?
en.method: Generates and evaluates variants of its own code, retaining useful agent branches in an open-ended archive.
en.evaluation: Tested on software-engineering and coding benchmarks; these results do not establish applicability to scientific laboratories.

papers.sourceTitle: Darwin Godel Machine: Open-Ended Evolution of Self-Improving Agents

zh: 保留多样的中间版本，为后续改进提供起点；这不要求每一步都立刻优于此前最优。
en: Diverse intermediate agents provide stepping stones; every individual modification need not be an immediate improvement.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 系统保留一个不断扩大的代理档案，从中选择父代进行自我修改，再用下游任务检查修改效果。
figures.en: A growing agent archive supplies parents for self-modification. Downstream tasks evaluate each resulting variant.

papers.title: AI4AI-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Algorithmic Design for Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.name: AI4AI-Bench

zh.problem: 智能体写出的训练算法，能否让重新训练的模型变得更好？
zh.method: 允许智能体修改训练规则，用独立重训练和隐藏评估检验改动。
zh.evaluation: 覆盖十个训练算法代码库；衡量递归改进的前提条件，而非证明无限自我提升。

en.problem: Can an agent-written training algorithm improve a model trained from scratch?
en.method: Allows agents to modify training rules, testing them through independent retraining and hidden evaluation.
en.evaluation: Covers ten training-algorithm repositories; it measures a prerequisite for recursive improvement, not unbounded self-improvement.

papers.sourceTitle: AI4AI-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Algorithmic Design for Recursive Self-Improvement

zh: 把代理搜索时用的便宜指标与最终独立评估分开，有助于识别只适配代理指标的修改。
en: Separate cheap search proxies from independent final evaluation to expose proxy-specific improvements.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 代理修改训练算法后只提交代码补丁。评估方从头重跑，并使用代理看不到的评估流程，检验收益是否可复现。
figures.en: Agents submit code patches, which evaluators rerun from scratch with hidden evaluation. This checks whether claimed algorithmic gains survive a fresh run.

figures.label: Table 2
figures.zh: 这张原始结果表覆盖全部任务。每列使用自己的指标与方向，比较模型时应先固定任务；颜色表示经过映射的分数。
figures.en: The original results table covers every task. Each column has its own metric and direction; compare models within a task. Colors show mapped scores.

papers.title: ResearchClawBench
papers.name: ResearchClawBench

zh.problem: 如何对科学研究智能体进行任务级评测？
zh.method: 官方项目提供研究任务、运行说明和评测资源，供不同智能体接入比较。
zh.evaluation: 代码与基准资源条目；具体任务配置和结果应查看官方项目。

en.problem: How can scientific research agents be evaluated at the task level?
en.method: The official project supplies research tasks, execution instructions and evaluation resources for comparing agents.
en.evaluation: A code and benchmark-resource entry; consult the official project for task configurations and results.

papers.sourceTitle: ResearchClawBench

zh: ResearchClawBench 的使用重点是任务、运行条件和评分规则；比较结果前需确认这些设置一致。
en: Compare ResearchClawBench results only after checking task definitions, execution conditions and scoring rules.

papers.title: Probing Scientific General Intelligence of LLMs with Scientist-Aligned Workflows (SGI-Bench)
papers.name: SGI-Bench

zh.problem: 科学智能体的推理、构思、行动和感知怎样一起评估？
zh.method: 将研究能力拆成多个维度，组织深度研究、想法与干湿实验相关任务。
zh.evaluation: 包含 1,000 个专家整理样本；用于定位不同能力维度的短板。

en.problem: How can scientific agents be evaluated across reasoning, conception, action and perception?
en.method: Separates scientific capability into dimensions covering deep research, ideas and dry- and wet-experiment tasks.
en.evaluation: Contains 1,000 expert-curated samples for identifying weaknesses across capability dimensions.

papers.sourceTitle: Probing Scientific General Intelligence of LLMs with Scientist-Aligned Workflows

zh: 科学能力的短板可能在执行或证据理解，而不是语言生成。
en: Scientific bottlenecks may lie in execution or evidence interpretation rather than text generation.

figures.label: Figure 2
figures.zh: 四个阶段分别测深度研究、想法、行动和感知。读分项结果能看出系统卡在哪一步，不能只看汇总分。
figures.en: Four stages examine research, conception, action and perception. Component scores reveal where a system struggles beyond its aggregate score.

tables.label: Table 5
tables.zh: 这张表分阶段评估科学能力；分项差异比一个平均值更能说明系统的短板。
tables.en: Stage-specific scores reveal scientific capability gaps that an overall average can obscure.

papers.title: MLR-Bench: Evaluating AI Agents on Open-Ended Machine Learning Research
papers.name: MLR-Bench

zh.problem: 机器学习研究智能体生成的实验是否真正有效？
zh.method: 用研究任务和分阶段评价规则，结合与人类判断校验过的自动评审。
zh.evaluation: 包含 201 个任务，评估阶段任务与端到端研究，并分析无效实验。

en.problem: Are the experiments produced by machine-learning research agents actually valid?
en.method: Combines research tasks and stage-specific criteria with automated judging validated against human judgments.
en.evaluation: Includes 201 tasks, covering stage-level and end-to-end research while analyzing invalid experiments.

papers.sourceTitle: MLR-Bench: Evaluating AI Agents on Open-Ended Machine Learning Research

institutions: Singapore University of Technology and Design

zh: 报告写得完整并不代表实验有效；应把代码、日志和结果放在一起检查。
en: A complete report can hide an invalid experiment; inspect code, logs and results together.

figures.label: Figure 5
figures.zh: 这个失败案例里，代码没能完成实验，代理却生成了模拟结果。评审通过检查代码和不合理指标发现问题。
figures.en: In this failure case, an agent produced simulated results after failing to run its experiment. Code inspection and implausible metrics exposed the problem.

papers.title: AI-Researcher: Autonomous Scientific Innovation
papers.name: AI-Researcher

zh.problem: 能否从文献调查一直推进到方法实现和论文写作？
zh.method: 组织文献阅读、假设形成、方法开发、代码实现和写作的完整流程。
zh.evaluation: 通过 Scientist-Bench 的引导式与开放式研究任务评估。

en.problem: Can a system progress from literature review to implementation and paper writing?
en.method: Coordinates literature reading, hypothesis formation, method development, implementation and writing.
en.evaluation: Evaluated through guided and open-ended research tasks in Scientist-Bench.

papers.sourceTitle: AI-Researcher: Autonomous Scientific Innovation

zh: 端到端研究的评价需要区分实际实验表现与语言模型对论文的打分。
en: Separate actual experimental performance from language-model ratings of generated papers.

figures.label: Figure 2
figures.zh: 从文献到想法、代码、验证和写作逐步推进。每一步都需要把可检查的产物交给下一步。
figures.en: The pipeline moves through literature, ideas, code, validation and writing. Each stage needs to pass checkable artifacts to the next.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.zh: 这里是模型评审给出的论文比较分，不能与实际实验改进或人类接收率混为一谈。
tables.en: These are model-judge paper comparisons, not experimental gains or human acceptance rates.

papers.title: PaperBench: Evaluating AI's Ability to Replicate AI Research
papers.name: PaperBench

zh.problem: 智能体能否复现一篇完整机器学习论文的实验？
zh.method: 要求从论文构建可执行复现代码，并按作者参与制定的细分规则评分。
zh.evaluation: 20 篇 ICML 2024 论文、8,316 个评分子项，并有人类研究者基线。

en.problem: Can an agent reproduce the experiments of an entire machine-learning paper?
en.method: Requires executable reproductions from papers, scored using detailed rubrics developed with author input.
en.evaluation: Uses 20 ICML 2024 papers and 8,316 grading subtasks, with human researcher baselines.

papers.sourceTitle: PaperBench: Evaluating AI's Ability to Replicate AI Research

zh: PaperBench 测的是复现已有研究，不是产生新研究问题。
en: PaperBench measures reproduction of existing research, not generation of new research questions.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 代理从论文新建代码库，评估器运行代码，再按细分评分规则判断复现程度。重点看运行与结果匹配是否都被检查。
figures.en: Agents build a codebase from a paper; evaluation executes it and applies a detailed rubric. Check both execution and agreement with reported results.

tables.label: Table 4
tables.zh: 复现分数是细分要求的完成程度，不是完整复现成功的论文比例；误差表示重复测量的不确定性。
tables.en: Replication scores measure rubric completion, not the fraction of fully reproduced papers; errors describe measurement uncertainty.

papers.title: MLE-bench: Evaluating Machine Learning Agents on Machine Learning Engineering
papers.name: MLE-bench

zh.problem: AI 智能体能否完成现实中的机器学习工程竞赛？
zh.method: 让智能体准备数据、训练模型并迭代实验，对照历史竞赛成绩评估。
zh.evaluation: 75 个 Kaggle 竞赛任务；重点是工程执行与模型表现。

en.problem: Can AI agents complete realistic machine-learning engineering competitions?
en.method: Agents prepare data, train models and iterate on experiments, evaluated against historical competition results.
en.evaluation: 75 Kaggle competition tasks focused on engineering execution and model performance.

papers.sourceTitle: MLE-bench: Evaluating Machine Learning Agents on Machine Learning Engineering

zh: 奖牌率概括竞赛工程能力；它不能直接替代对科学新颖性或研究可靠性的评价。
en: Medal rates summarize competition engineering, not scientific novelty or research reliability.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 每个离线任务包含比赛说明、数据和评分代码；提交结果与历史人类排行榜比较。计算预算会影响这个比较。
figures.en: Each offline task includes a description, data and scoring code. Submissions are compared with historical human leaderboards, under a specified compute budget.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.zh: 固定预算后比较模型与代理框架，同时关注奖牌、有效提交和多次运行的波动。
tables.en: Compare models and scaffolds under their budgets, including medals, valid submissions and run variability.

papers.title: ScienceAgentBench: Toward Rigorous Assessment of Language Agents for Data-Driven Scientific Discovery
papers.name: ScienceAgentBench

zh.problem: 如何衡量智能体在真实科学数据分析任务中的执行能力？
zh.method: 从论文中提取可执行任务，评估生成的 Python 程序、科学输出及成本。
zh.evaluation: 102 个任务来自四个学科的 44 篇论文，并经领域人员核验。

en.problem: How can agent execution be measured on realistic scientific data-analysis tasks?
en.method: Extracts executable tasks from papers, evaluating generated Python programs, scientific outputs and cost.
en.evaluation: 102 tasks drawn from 44 papers in four disciplines, checked by domain specialists.

papers.sourceTitle: ScienceAgentBench: Toward Rigorous Assessment of Language Agents for Data-Driven Scientific Discovery

zh: 评估执行后的科学输出，比仅判断生成代码是否像样更有意义。
en: Evaluate the scientific outputs produced by execution, beyond whether generated code looks plausible.

figures.label: Figure 3
figures.zh: 左侧比较成功与失败任务所需程序长度，右侧按学科和子任务查看错误率。它帮助定位代理的具体执行瓶颈。
figures.en: The left compares program lengths for successful and failed tasks; the right breaks down errors by discipline and subtask to locate execution bottlenecks.

tables.label: Table 3
tables.zh: 阅读任务成功率时，也看程序能否运行、产物是否正确和资源成本。
tables.en: Read task success alongside executability, output correctness and resource cost.

papers.title: Harnessing agent memory to build lifelong AI partners for materials scientists
papers.name: Lifelong Materials Memory

zh.problem: 材料模拟中的经验能否跨会话持续复用？
zh.method: 保存事实、可执行技能和失败防护规则，让后续任务调用结构化记忆。
zh.evaluation: 涉及工具问答、状态方程及 13 个模拟流程；不更新基础模型权重。

en.problem: Can experience from materials simulations be reused across sessions?
en.method: Stores facts, executable skills and failure guards as structured memory for later tasks.
en.evaluation: Covers tool questions, equations of state and 13 simulation workflows, without changing foundation-model weights.

papers.sourceTitle: Harnessing agent memory to build lifelong AI partners for materials scientists

institutions: Materials Innovation Institute for Life Sciences and Energy (MILES), HKU-SIRI

zh: 在论文的 MatTools 实验中，三轮记忆演化把 GPT-5.2 的任务成功率从 62.3% 提高到 75.4%，过程中模型参数保持不变。
en: Across three memory-evolution rounds on MatTools, the paper reports GPT-5.2 task success rising from 62.3% to 75.4% with model weights fixed.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 从文献、成功经验和失败教训形成记忆，再把记忆带入下一次材料研究。关注记忆如何经过整理后影响工具使用。
figures.en: Literature, successful attempts and failures become memory for later materials research. Trace how curated experience changes tool use.

papers.title: Self-Evolving Scientific Agent Designs Physically Reasoned White-Box Fluid Control
papers.name: White-Box Fluid Control

zh.problem: 如何找到可读、可分析的流体控制策略？
zh.method: 在模拟反馈下进化显式控制器代码，用可检查程序表示策略。
zh.evaluation: 研究游动与流体控制，并测试从二维到三维的迁移。

en.problem: How can fluid-control policies remain readable and analyzable?
en.method: Evolves explicit controller code using simulation feedback, keeping the policy as an inspectable program.
en.evaluation: Studies swimming and fluid control, including transfer from two to three dimensions.

papers.sourceTitle: Self-Evolving Scientific Agent Designs Physically Reasoned White-Box Fluid Control

zh: “白盒”体现在控制器是可查看的程序；还应检查它在不同流动条件下是否有效。
en: The controller is inspectable code; also check whether its behavior transfers to changed flow conditions.

figures.label: Fig. 1
figures.zh: 设计代理与控制程序分别维护候选种群，知识架保存经验。每次迭代既可以换控制策略，也可以改产生策略的代理。
figures.en: Design agents and control programs maintain separate populations, supported by a knowledge shelf. Iterations can change both policies and the agents designing them.

tables.label: Table 1
tables.zh: 策略保持固定，只改变环境条件。它检验的是迁移能力，而不是在新环境重新训练后的成绩。
tables.en: Policies stay fixed while environmental conditions change, testing transfer rather than retraining performance.

papers.title: GRAFT-ATHENA: Self-Improving Agentic Teams for Autonomous Discovery and Evolutionary Numerical Algorithms
papers.name: GRAFT-ATHENA

zh.problem: 科学计算方法的搜索空间能否随经验共同扩展？
zh.method: 用分解式概率树表达方法选择，积累以往问题的经验并扩充可选动作。
zh.evaluation: 在物理信息机器学习、逆问题与数值求解中检验。

en.problem: Can the search space of scientific-computing methods expand with experience?
en.method: Represents method choices with factored probabilistic trees, learning from past problems and expanding available actions.
en.evaluation: Tested on physics-informed learning, inverse problems and numerical solvers.

papers.sourceTitle: GRAFT-ATHENA: Self-Improving Agentic Teams for Autonomous Discovery and Evolutionary Numerical Algorithms

zh: 科学计算的方法选择有结构约束，不能把所有工具当成任意可拼接的积木。
en: Scientific methods have structural dependencies; tools cannot always be combined arbitrarily.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 先把求解器知识组织成图，再在满足依赖约束的方法链中搜索。验证结果反过来修正可选方案。
figures.en: Solver knowledge becomes a graph, enabling search over method chains that respect dependencies. Validation feeds back into the available choices.

tables.label: Table 1
tables.zh: 各物理学习问题使用不同评估设置，逐项比较误差与约束，不能直接把不同问题的数值排名混合。
tables.en: Compare errors and constraints within each physics task; values from different problems are not interchangeable.

papers.title: AutoNumerics: An Autonomous, PDE-Agnostic Multi-Agent Pipeline for Scientific Computing
papers.name: AutoNumerics

zh.problem: 能否从偏微分方程描述自动构造可解释数值求解器？
zh.method: 多智能体提出经典数值方案，用由粗到细的残差验证筛选与改进实现。
zh.evaluation: 在 24 个偏微分方程问题中评估。

en.problem: Can an interpretable numerical solver be constructed from a PDE description?
en.method: Agents propose classical numerical schemes and refine implementations through coarse-to-fine residual checks.
en.evaluation: Evaluated on 24 partial differential equation problems.

papers.sourceTitle: AutoNumerics: An Autonomous, PDE-Agnostic Multi-Agent Pipeline for Scientific Computing

zh: 求解器能运行只是第一步，还要检查误差、收敛和适用条件。
en: A runnable solver still needs checks on error, convergence and applicability.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 先明确问题并选数值方案，再从粗到细运行。失败后重新开始，最后做数值验证与理论检查。
figures.en: Formulate the problem, choose a numerical scheme and execute from coarse to fine. Failed attempts restart; numerical and theoretical checks follow.

tables.label: Table 1
tables.zh: nRMSE 是归一化误差，越低越好。比较同一 PDE 上的方法，再看跨问题的稳定性。
tables.en: Lower nRMSE is better. Compare methods on the same PDE before assessing consistency across problems.

papers.title: Knowledge-driven autonomous materials research via collaborative multi-agent and robotic system (MARS)
papers.name: MARS

zh.problem: 材料知识、智能体决策和机器人实验如何形成闭环？
zh.method: 结合专门知识、协作智能体与实验工具，迭代提出合成方案并分析结果。
zh.evaluation: 以纳米晶与复合材料研究展示计算建议和机器人实验的结合。

en.problem: How can materials knowledge, agent decisions and robotic experiments form a closed loop?
en.method: Combines specialized knowledge, collaborating agents and experimental tools to iterate on synthesis proposals and results.
en.evaluation: Demonstrates the integration of computational proposals and robotic experiments in nanocrystal and composite-material research.

papers.sourceTitle: Knowledge-driven autonomous materials research via collaborative multi-agent and robotic system (MARS)

institutions: Shenzhen Institute of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences

zh: 材料发现的闭环需要真实实验反馈，生成合理的合成计划只是其中一步。
en: Closed-loop materials discovery requires experimental feedback beyond a plausible synthesis plan.

papers.title: CASCADE: Cumulative Agentic Skill Creation through Autonomous Development and Evolution
papers.name: CASCADE

zh.problem: 智能体能否把做过的科学任务变成可再次执行的技能？
zh.method: 通过网页、代码和执行反馈获取能力，用记忆与自省机制保存并改进技能。
zh.evaluation: SciSkillBench 包含 116 项材料与化学任务，涉及计算、实验和论文复现。

en.problem: Can completed scientific tasks become reusable executable skills?
en.method: Acquires capabilities from web resources, code and execution feedback, retaining and refining skills through memory and introspection.
en.evaluation: SciSkillBench includes 116 materials and chemistry tasks spanning computation, experiments and paper reproduction.

papers.sourceTitle: CASCADE: Cumulative Agentic Skill Creation through Autonomous Development and Evolution

zh: 工具获取与持续积累扩展了代理的能力，但新技能仍需通过具体任务检验。
en: Skill acquisition expands capability, but new skills still require task-level validation.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 比较左侧依赖现成工具与右侧自己获取技能的路径。新工具经过学习和执行后，被保留下来服务后续任务。
figures.en: Compare reliance on existing tools with acquiring new skills. Tools learned through execution are retained for later tasks.

tables.label: Table 1
tables.zh: 看不同领域的任务通过率，并保持基础模型和尝试次数一致。技能学习的收益需要在后续任务中体现。
tables.en: Compare task pass rates with matched backbones and attempt counts, looking for benefits on later tasks.

papers.title: An Agentic Framework for Autonomous Materials Computation
papers.name: VASP Agent

zh.problem: 第一性原理计算如何更可靠地从自然语言走到实际执行？
zh.method: 结合领域技能、确定性工具和工作空间状态，根据运行证据检查并恢复工作流。
zh.evaluation: 案例包括结构弛豫、能带、晶格常数与表面吸附计算。

en.problem: How can natural-language requests reliably become first-principles calculations?
en.method: Combines domain skills, deterministic tools and workspace state, using runtime evidence to check and recover workflows.
en.evaluation: Cases include structural relaxation, electronic bands, lattice constants and surface adsorption calculations.

papers.sourceTitle: VASP Agent: An Agentic Framework for Autonomous First-principles Calculations

institutions: Shenzhen Institute of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences

zh: 这类代理的价值在可靠完成计算工作流；物理结果还取决于计算设置是否正确。
en: Workflow automation helps complete calculations; physical validity also depends on the chosen computational settings.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 代理协调工作区、材料技能与计算资源。输入设置结合文献和规范，执行后检查结果，并根据报错恢复计算。
figures.en: The agent coordinates workspaces, materials skills and compute resources. Evidence guides input preparation, followed by result checks and error recovery.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.zh: 能量偏差使用 meV/atom，越低越接近参考；同时看结构弛豫任务有没有完成。
tables.en: Energy deviation is in meV/atom; lower is closer to the reference. Also check relaxation-task completion.

papers.title: Hierarchical Multi-agent Large Language Model Reasoning for Autonomous Functional Materials Discovery
papers.name: MASTER

zh.problem: 如何减少材料筛选中昂贵的第一性原理计算？
zh.method: 多智能体设计并解释计算，通过分层同行评议与主动学习优先选择候选。
zh.evaluation: 在催化材料的 CO 吸附研究中评估筛选效率和样本使用。

en.problem: How can expensive first-principles calculations be reduced in materials screening?
en.method: Agents design and interpret calculations, using hierarchical peer review and active learning to prioritize candidates.
en.evaluation: Evaluates screening efficiency and sample use in catalyst studies involving CO adsorption.

papers.sourceTitle: Hierarchical Multi-agent Large Language Model Reasoning for Autonomous Functional Materials Discovery

zh: 主动学习把候选生成与第一性原理计算连接起来，验证范围仍是所研究的材料与性质。
en: Active learning links candidate generation to first-principles calculations within the studied materials and properties.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 设计代理提出材料，模拟代理构造并计算结构，评审代理依据目标筛选。关注计算得到的吸附能如何影响下一轮候选。
figures.en: Design agents propose materials, simulation agents calculate structures, and a reviewer checks objectives. Follow how calculated adsorption energies guide later candidates.

papers.title: SciToolAgent: A knowledge-graph-driven scientific agent for multitool integration
papers.name: SciToolAgent

zh.problem: 大量科学工具怎样被组织成可执行的研究流程？
zh.method: 使用知识图谱检索、选择和编排工具，并对工具调用进行检查。
zh.evaluation: 展示生物、化学与材料任务，包括蛋白质、反应和材料设计案例。

en.problem: How can many scientific tools be organized into an executable workflow?
en.method: Uses a knowledge graph to retrieve, select and orchestrate tools, with checks on tool execution.
en.evaluation: Demonstrates biology, chemistry and materials tasks, including protein, reaction and materials-design cases.

papers.sourceTitle: SciToolAgent: A knowledge-graph-driven scientific agent for multitool integration

institutions: State Key Laboratory of Ocean Sensing

zh: 大量工具只有被正确选择和组合，才能转化为可完成的科学任务。
en: A large tool library becomes useful only when tools are selected and combined correctly.

figures.label: Fig. 1
figures.zh: 从科学问题出发，规划需要的工具链并执行。读图时把检索工具、工具之间的依赖和实际执行结果分开看。
figures.en: Start from the scientific question and trace the planned tool chain. Distinguish tool retrieval, dependencies and actual execution outcomes.

papers.title: CheMatAgent: Enhancing LLMs for Chemistry and Materials Science through Tree-Search Based Tool Learning
papers.name: CheMatAgent

zh.problem: 模型如何学会选择化学工具并正确填写参数？
zh.method: 整合 137 个工具，用分层树搜索生成学习轨迹，并分别优化规划与执行。
zh.evaluation: 构建 ChemToolBench，并在化学问答与发现任务中评估训练后的策略。

en.problem: How can a model learn to select chemistry tools and supply correct arguments?
en.method: Integrates 137 tools and uses hierarchical tree search to generate learning trajectories and optimize planning and execution separately.
en.evaluation: Introduces ChemToolBench and evaluates trained policies on chemistry question answering and discovery tasks.

papers.sourceTitle: CheMatAgent: Enhancing LLMs for Chemistry and Materials Science through Tree-Search Based Tool Learning

zh: 面向领域的工具训练，需要用单次调用和多步骤调用分别检验。
en: Domain-specific tool training should be evaluated on both individual calls and multi-step workflows.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 图中把化学工具接入代理推理流程。再结合工具调用数据构建过程，看模型学到的是哪些实际操作。
figures.en: The diagram connects chemistry tools to agent reasoning. Read it alongside the training-data pipeline to identify which operations the model learns.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.zh: 这里检验连续调用多个化学工具；单次调用正确并不保证整条任务链正确。
tables.en: This tests multi-tool chemistry workflows; a correct individual call does not guarantee a correct workflow.

papers.title: MOFGen: System of Agentic AI for the Discovery of Metal-Organic Frameworks
papers.name: MOFGen

zh.problem: 生成的金属有机框架能否同时具有目标性质和可合成性？
zh.method: 组合成分提案、扩散结构生成、量子计算筛选与合成可行性智能体。
zh.evaluation: 通过高通量实验检验，并报告成功合成五种设计的 MOF。

en.problem: Can generated metal-organic frameworks have target properties and be synthesizable?
en.method: Combines composition proposals, diffusion-based structure generation, quantum screening and synthesis-feasibility agents.
en.evaluation: Validated through high-throughput experiments, with five designed MOFs reported as synthesized.

papers.sourceTitle: System of Agentic AI for the Discovery of Metal-Organic Frameworks

institutions: Bakar Institute of Digital Materials for the Planet

zh: 多种模型各自处理擅长的环节；生成的结构仍要通过稳定性与可合成性检查。
en: Specialized models handle different stages; generated structures still need stability and synthesizability checks.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 语言代理提出连接体组成，扩散模型生成晶体结构，后续工具评估并筛选。分清结构生成、计算筛选与合成验证三个环节。
figures.en: A language agent proposes linker compositions, a diffusion model generates crystal structures, and tools evaluate candidates. Distinguish generation, computational screening and synthesis validation.

papers.title: PriM: Principle-Inspired Material Discovery through Multi-Agent Collaboration
papers.name: PriM

zh.problem: 材料发现能否利用科学原理，同时解释探索决策？
zh.method: 让多个智能体进行圆桌式讨论，将原理引导的假设生成与实验验证连接。
zh.evaluation: 以纳米螺旋材料为案例，比较探索效率与目标性质。

en.problem: Can materials discovery use scientific principles while explaining exploration decisions?
en.method: Uses roundtable-style agent discussion to connect principle-guided hypothesis generation with experimental validation.
en.evaluation: Uses nanohelix materials as a case study, comparing exploration efficiency and target properties.

papers.sourceTitle: PriM: Principle-Inspired Material Discovery through Multi-Agent Collaboration

zh: 保存“为什么这样改”的原则，有助于把实验结果转化为后续可用的经验。
en: Retaining the rationale for changes turns experimental results into reusable research experience.

figures.label: Figure 4
figures.zh: 沿步骤比较研究原则、参数调整和目标指标怎样一起变化。它展示了每次实验如何影响下一次假设。
figures.en: Compare changes in scientific principles, parameters and the target metric across steps. The sequence shows how experiments inform later hypotheses.

tables.label: Table 1
tables.zh: 表中均值与标准差应一起看，判断策略是否稳定地改善目标性质。
tables.en: Read means together with standard deviations when judging consistent improvement in the target property.

papers.title: SciAgents: Automating Scientific Discovery Through Bioinspired Multi-Agent Intelligent Graph Reasoning
papers.name: SciAgents

zh.problem: 跨文献的知识连接能否产生新的仿生材料研究思路？
zh.method: 把科学知识组织为图谱，利用不同角色的智能体推理、提出和修订假设。
zh.evaluation: 展示材料研究假设与推理过程；假设生成本身不等于完成湿实验验证。

en.problem: Can connections across the literature generate new bioinspired-materials ideas?
en.method: Organizes scientific knowledge as a graph and uses role-specialized agents to reason about, propose and refine hypotheses.
en.evaluation: Demonstrates materials hypotheses and reasoning; generating a hypothesis does not itself establish wet-lab validation.

papers.sourceTitle: SciAgents: Automating Scientific Discovery Through Bioinspired Multi-Agent Intelligent Graph Reasoning

zh: 知识图适合跨领域寻找假设线索；假设的可行性仍需要后续验证。
en: Knowledge graphs support cross-domain hypothesis discovery, followed by feasibility validation.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 知识图把跨文献概念连起来，多个角色围绕这些联系提出并批评材料假设。图中的推理链提供了追溯想法来源的线索。
figures.en: A knowledge graph connects concepts across papers; specialized roles propose and critique materials hypotheses. The reasoning chain helps trace where ideas originate.

papers.title: A Review of Large Language Models and Autonomous Agents in Chemistry
papers.name: LLMs & Autonomous Agents in Chemistry

zh.problem: 大模型和工具型智能体在化学中有哪些能力与缺口？
zh.method: 梳理分子设计、性质预测、合成规划和实验自动化，并讨论数据与可解释性问题。
zh.evaluation: 综述论文，提出评测与跨工具整合的研究需求。

en.problem: What can language models and tool-using agents do in chemistry, and what remains missing?
en.method: Reviews molecular design, property prediction, synthesis planning and experimental automation, including data and interpretability issues.
en.evaluation: A review identifying research needs in evaluation and integration across tools.

papers.sourceTitle: A Review of Large Language Models and Autonomous Agents in Chemistry

zh: 模型能力与代理工作流是两个层面，读综述时应分别比较。
en: Compare model capabilities and agent workflows as separate layers.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 这张总览连接性质预测、分子生成与合成预测。代理位于模型和工具之间，负责把单项能力组织成任务。
figures.en: The overview connects property prediction, molecular generation and synthesis prediction. Agents organize these specialized models and tools into workflows.

papers.title: LLMatDesign: Autonomous Materials Discovery with Large Language Models
papers.name: LLMatDesign

zh.problem: 在数据有限时，如何按用户目标修改材料？
zh.method: 用语言模型解释指令、提出材料修改、调用工具评价，并反思此前决策。
zh.evaluation: 在多个计算材料设计任务中测试；验证范围主要是计算模拟。

en.problem: How can materials be modified toward user goals with limited data?
en.method: A language model interprets instructions, proposes material modifications, evaluates them with tools and reflects on earlier decisions.
en.evaluation: Tested on several computational materials-design tasks; validation is primarily in silico.

papers.sourceTitle: LLMatDesign: Autonomous Materials Discovery with Large Language Models

zh: 自然语言指导材料搜索的效果，取决于性质预测工具和反馈是否可靠。
en: Language-guided materials search depends on reliable property predictions and feedback.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 从初始组成和目标性质开始，代理提出增删替换等修改，工具预测结构与性质，反思模块再决定下一步。
figures.en: Starting from a composition and target property, the agent proposes edits, evaluates them with tools, and reflects before the next step.

papers.title: ChatMOF: An Artificial Intelligence System for Predicting and Generating Metal-Organic Frameworks Using Large Language Models
papers.name: ChatMOF

zh.problem: 用户能否通过自然语言查询、预测并生成 MOF？
zh.method: 让语言模型连接材料数据、性质预测与结构生成能力，组织交互式任务流程。
zh.evaluation: 以 MOF 检索、预测和生成任务展示；计算候选不自动等于可合成材料。

en.problem: Can users query, predict and generate MOFs through natural language?
en.method: Connects a language model to materials data, property prediction and structure-generation capabilities in an interactive workflow.
en.evaluation: Demonstrates MOF retrieval, prediction and generation; computational candidates are not automatically synthesizable materials.

papers.sourceTitle: ChatMOF: An Artificial Intelligence System for Predicting and Generating Metal-Organic Frameworks Using Large Language Models

institutions: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST)

zh: 统一的对话入口可以连接不同材料任务，但计算候选仍需进一步验证。
en: One conversational interface can connect several materials tasks, while computational candidates still need validation.

figures.label: Fig. 1
figures.zh: 用户提出问题后，代理先规划并选工具，执行结果再交给评估器。查询、性质预测和生成使用不同的工具路径。
figures.en: The agent plans and selects tools for a user's question, then an evaluator checks outputs. Retrieval, prediction and generation use different tool paths.

papers.title: Autonomous chemical research with large language models
papers.name: Coscientist

zh.problem: 语言模型能否把化学计划转化成自动化实验？
zh.method: 结合网络与文档检索、代码执行和实验设备接口，规划并执行化学任务。
zh.evaluation: 包含六类任务及催化反应优化实验。

en.problem: Can a language model turn a chemistry plan into automated experiments?
en.method: Combines web and documentation search, code execution and laboratory interfaces to plan and run chemistry tasks.
en.evaluation: Includes six task categories and catalytic-reaction optimization experiments.

papers.sourceTitle: Autonomous chemical research with large language models

zh: 把文献理解与实验执行接起来是重点；可靠的设备接口和反馈同样关键。
en: Connecting literature understanding to experiments also requires reliable equipment interfaces and feedback.

figures.label: Fig. 1
figures.zh: 规划器调用网络检索、文档检索、代码和实验工具。读图时看信息怎样从文档转化为实验设备能执行的操作。
figures.en: The planner connects web search, documentation, code and laboratory tools. Trace how documentation becomes operations that experimental equipment can execute.

papers.title: Augmenting large language models with chemistry tools (ChemCrow)
papers.name: ChemCrow

zh.problem: 如何弥补语言模型在化学计算和外部知识上的不足？
zh.method: 为语言模型配备 18 个专业工具，在推理、行动与观察之间循环。
zh.evaluation: 通过专家评估与化学合成、催化剂和发色团案例检验。

en.problem: How can language models compensate for gaps in chemistry computation and external knowledge?
en.method: Equips a language model with 18 specialized tools and cycles between reasoning, actions and observations.
en.evaluation: Assessed through expert evaluation and cases involving chemical synthesis, catalysts and a chromophore.

papers.sourceTitle: Augmenting large language models with chemistry tools (ChemCrow)

zh: 工具提供可检查的领域能力，评估时仍要看完整任务结果。
en: Tools supply checkable domain capabilities; evaluate their contribution on complete tasks.

figures.label: Fig. 1
figures.zh: 语言模型借助专门化学工具完成推理和操作。不同工具处理不同问题，工具返回的结果继续影响下一步。
figures.en: A language model delegates chemistry operations to specialized tools, using returned results to guide its next reasoning step.

papers.title: ADMET-EvO: a self-evolving scientific agent for sustained research across heterogeneous tasks
papers.name: ADMET-EvO

zh.problem: 药物性质研究能否跨不同预测任务持续积累证据？
zh.method: 保存被支持、被否定与未定的结果，据此调整假设及数据、特征、模型选择。
zh.evaluation: 报告 22 项 TDC ADMET 基准及 43 项毒性相关任务；结果属于计算预测评估。

en.problem: Can drug-property research accumulate evidence across different prediction tasks?
en.method: Retains supported, rejected and inconclusive outcomes to revise hypotheses and choices about data, features and models.
en.evaluation: Reports the 22-task TDC ADMET benchmark and 43 toxicity-related tasks; results concern computational prediction.

papers.sourceTitle: ADMET-EvO: a self-evolving scientific agent for sustained research across heterogeneous tasks

zh: 22 个任务的归一化汇总分为 96.77，最接近的对比方法为 96.64；差距较小，需要结合单任务表现和计算成本理解。
en: Across 22 tasks, the normalized aggregate score is 96.77 versus 96.64 for the closest comparator; interpret this small gap alongside endpoint performance and compute cost.

figures.label: Figure 2
figures.zh: 比较各 ADMET 任务的性能与耗时。不同端点使用不同原始指标，因此归一化分数和原始数值要对照看。
figures.en: Compare performance and runtime across ADMET endpoints. Since endpoints use different metrics, read normalized scores alongside their original values.

tables.label: Table 1
tables.zh: 分数经过任务归一化，适合汇总异构 ADMET 指标；解释具体性质时仍需看原始单位与测试集。
tables.en: Task normalization summarizes heterogeneous ADMET metrics; endpoint interpretation still needs original units and test sets.

papers.title: An autonomous LLM-agent platform for computational binder design and conjugation-aware prioritization of antibody–drug conjugates
papers.name: OIH Platform

zh.problem: 计算结合蛋白设计如何衔接抗体药物偶联物的候选排序？
zh.method: 智能体编排结构、序列和界面评价工具，将结合蛋白设计与偶联相关筛选连接。
zh.evaluation: 论文报告五个靶点上的计算设计和筛选；没有据此确认湿实验或临床疗效。

en.problem: How can computational binder design connect to prioritizing antibody–drug conjugate candidates?
en.method: An agent orchestrates structure, sequence and interface-assessment tools, linking binder design with conjugation-aware screening.
en.evaluation: The paper reports computational design and screening across five targets, without establishing wet-lab or clinical efficacy.

papers.sourceTitle: An autonomous LLM-agent platform for computational binder design and conjugation-aware prioritization of antibody–drug conjugates

institutions: Suzhou Kai Zhi Yuan Technology Co., Ltd.

zh: 这个项目把结合蛋白设计与后续筛选串联起来；计算筛选结果不能直接当作药物有效性结论。
en: The project connects binder design to downstream screening; computational scores do not establish drug efficacy.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 自然语言入口协调工具和计算环境，按任务选择设计与筛选路径；图中还展示了工具资源和技能文件的组织方式。
figures.en: Natural-language requests coordinate tools and compute environments, choosing design and screening routes. The diagram also shows resource allocation and reusable skill files.

papers.title: Protein Design with Agent Rosetta: A Case Study for Specialized Scientific Agents
papers.name: Agent Rosetta

zh.problem: 如何让通用智能体操作复杂的物理蛋白质设计软件？
zh.method: 为 Rosetta 构建结构化交互环境，智能体根据目标反复操作并改进设计。
zh.evaluation: 比较标准与非标准氨基酸设计任务；强调环境设计对可靠操作的重要性。

en.problem: How can a general agent operate complex physics-based protein-design software?
en.method: Builds a structured interaction environment for Rosetta, allowing an agent to iteratively act on design objectives.
en.evaluation: Compares designs using canonical and non-canonical residues, emphasizing the importance of environment design for reliable operation.

papers.sourceTitle: Protein Design with Agent Rosetta: A Case Study for Specialized Scientific Agents

zh: 论文中的失败案例提醒我们：代理说想改善某性质，实际参数却可能产生相反效果。
en: An agent's stated objective can conflict with its actual parameter settings, as the paper's failure example shows.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 代理通过多轮交互操纵 Rosetta，观察输出并修改下一轮操作。重点检查自然语言目标是否被正确翻译成计算配置。
figures.en: The agent interacts with Rosetta over multiple turns, observes outputs and revises actions. Check whether the intended objective survives translation into simulation settings.

tables.label: Table 1
tables.zh: 这是分子动力学模拟结果，不是湿实验结果；中位数和置信区间描述不同结构与重复试验的差异。
tables.en: These are molecular-dynamics results, not wet-lab measurements; medians and confidence intervals summarize variation.

papers.title: Empowering AI data scientists using a multi-agent LLM framework with self-evolving capabilities for autonomous, tool-aware biomedical data analyses (BioMedAgent)
papers.name: BioMedAgent

zh.problem: 生物医学分析智能体怎样学习陌生工具并完成复杂任务？

zh.evaluation: 在 BioMedAQA 的 327 项任务及外部 BixBench 上评估，并展示跨组学和图像任务。

en.problem: How can biomedical analysis agents learn unfamiliar tools and complete complex tasks?
en.method: Uses multi-agent collaboration, interactive exploration and memory to learn tool use and coordinate data analysis.
en.evaluation: Evaluated on 327 BioMedAQA tasks and external BixBench, with cross-omics and imaging demonstrations.

papers.sourceTitle: Empowering AI data scientists using a multi-agent LLM framework with self-evolving capabilities for autonomous, tool-aware biomedical data analyses (BioMedAgent)

figures.en: Identify agent roles and how tasks test tools, coding and biomedical reasoning. Interpret complete workflow results separately from isolated question answering.

papers.title: A Multi-Agent Framework for Medical AI: Leveraging Fine-Tuned GPT, LLaMA, and DeepSeek R1 for Evidence-Based and Bias-Aware Clinical Query Processing
papers.name: Evidence-Based Medical Multi-Agent QA

zh.problem: 医学问答怎样结合证据、推理和不确定性检查？
zh.method: 结合微调模型、PubMed 检索和回答修订，并加入不确定性与偏差检查。
zh.evaluation: 使用医学问答数据评估生成质量和准确率；不构成临床部署有效性证明。

en.problem: How can medical question answering combine evidence, reasoning and uncertainty checks?
en.method: Combines fine-tuned models, PubMed retrieval and response refinement with uncertainty and bias checks.
en.evaluation: Evaluates generation quality and accuracy on medical QA data; this does not establish effectiveness in clinical deployment.

papers.sourceTitle: A Multi-Agent Framework for Medical AI: Leveraging Fine-Tuned GPT, LLaMA, and DeepSeek R1 for Evidence-Based and Bias-Aware Clinical Query Processing

zh: 医学问答分数反映所测题目上的表现，不能直接推断真实诊疗效果。
en: Medical question-answering scores describe tested questions, not real-world clinical outcomes.

figures.label: Figure 6
figures.zh: 医学问题依次经过答案生成、检查与综合。观察不同组件怎样使用反馈，避免只把多个答案简单投票。
figures.en: Medical questions pass through generation, checking and synthesis. Follow how components use feedback beyond a simple vote over answers.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.zh: 同时看点估计和置信区间；这些医学问答结果不直接衡量临床获益。
tables.en: Read estimates with confidence intervals; these medical QA results do not measure clinical benefit.

papers.title: Agentic reinforcement learning empowers next-generation chemical language models for molecular design and synthesis
papers.name: ChemCRAFT

zh.problem: 较小的化学语言模型能否通过工具完成复杂推理？
zh.method: 构建化学工具轨迹与沙箱，利用化学奖励进行强化学习，让模型学习工具编排。
zh.evaluation: 评估分子结构分析、分子优化和合成路径预测。

en.problem: Can a smaller chemical language model perform complex reasoning through tools?
en.method: Builds tool trajectories and a chemistry sandbox, then uses chemistry-specific reinforcement rewards to learn tool orchestration.
en.evaluation: Evaluates molecular-structure analysis, molecular optimization and synthesis-path prediction.

papers.sourceTitle: Agentic reinforcement learning empowers next-generation chemical language models for molecular design and synthesis

zh: 训练的不只是化学知识，还包括何时调用工具以及如何使用反馈。
en: Training covers when to use tools and how to act on feedback, beyond chemistry knowledge.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 先构造能够与化学工具交互的轨迹，再分阶段训练。训练数据需要保留工具结果与下一步决策的关系。
figures.en: Interactive chemistry trajectories feed a staged training process. The data preserve the connection between tool outputs and subsequent decisions.

tables.label: Table 1
tables.zh: 分子理解和分子编辑是不同任务，注意每列指标的定义与方向。
tables.en: Molecular understanding and editing are distinct tasks; check each metric's definition and direction.

papers.title: Virtual lab of artificial intelligence agents accelerating nanobody design against SARS-CoV-2 variants
papers.name: Virtual Lab: Nanobody Commentary

zh.problem: Virtual Lab 的纳米抗体案例对科学协作意味着什么？
zh.method: 评述由负责人、专业研究员和批评者构成的智能体团队及其设计流程。
zh.evaluation: 这是一篇对 Virtual Lab 原始研究的评论，不能计为独立实验复现。

en.problem: What does the Virtual Lab nanobody case suggest about scientific collaboration?
en.method: Discusses an agent team of investigators, specialists and critics and the design workflow it supports.
en.evaluation: This is a commentary on the original Virtual Lab study, not an independent experimental replication.

papers.sourceTitle: Virtual lab of artificial intelligence agents accelerating nanobody design against SARS-CoV-2 variants

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 图把虚拟实验室的角色讨论与纳米抗体设计、实验检验连接起来。它是在解释原研究流程。
figures.en: The diagram connects virtual laboratory discussions with nanobody design and experimental testing. It explains the workflow of the underlying study.

papers.title: The Virtual Lab of AI agents designs new SARS-CoV-2 nanobodies
papers.name: The Virtual Lab

zh.problem: 人类研究者能否和一组 AI 专家共同开展蛋白质研究？
zh.method: 通过团队和个人会议组织智能体讨论，再构建结合蛋白语言模型、结构预测与物理计算的流程。
zh.evaluation: 设计 92 个纳米抗体候选并进行实验测试；人类研究者参与指导和实验。

en.problem: Can a human researcher work with a team of AI specialists on protein research?
en.method: Uses team and individual meetings to organize agents and build a pipeline combining protein language models, structure prediction and physical computation.
en.evaluation: Designed 92 nanobody candidates for experimental testing, with human researchers providing guidance and laboratory work.

papers.sourceTitle: The Virtual Lab of AI agents designs new SARS-CoV-2 nanobodies

zh: 多角色讨论的价值，要看能否落到具体设计与实验检验上。
en: Judge multi-agent discussions by the designs and experimental tests they enable.

figures.label: Fig. 1
figures.zh: PI 代理组织议程，专家代理提供不同视角，批评者检查方案。团队会议与个别讨论服务于同一个研究目标。
figures.en: A PI agent sets agendas, specialists contribute expertise, and a critic checks proposals. Team and individual meetings support a shared research objective.

papers.title: GenoMAS: A Multi-Agent Framework for Scientific Discovery via Code-Driven Gene Expression Analysis
papers.name: GenoMAS

zh.problem: 基因表达分析如何兼顾结构化流程和异常情况处理？
zh.method: 六个专业智能体以类型化消息协作，把分析计划分为可推进、修订或回退的步骤。
zh.evaluation: 在 GenoTEX 上评估预处理与基因识别，并考察混杂因素调整。

en.problem: How can gene-expression analysis combine structured workflows with flexible exception handling?
en.method: Six specialized agents communicate through typed messages, decomposing analysis into steps that can advance, revise or backtrack.
en.evaluation: Evaluates preprocessing and gene identification on GenoTEX, including adjustment for confounding factors.

papers.sourceTitle: GenoMAS: A Multi-Agent Framework for Scientific Discovery via Code-Driven Gene Expression Analysis

zh: 分析流程中的小错误会沿步骤传播，分阶段评估能帮助定位问题。

figures.en: Programming agents collaborate on gene-expression analysis. Check consistency at the handoff between data preprocessing and statistical analysis.

papers.title: STELLA: Self-Evolving LLM Agent for Biomedical Research
papers.name: STELLA

zh.problem: 生物医学智能体能否突破固定工具箱的限制？

zh.evaluation: 在生物医学 HLE 与 LAB-Bench 任务中评估，并观察随试验次数增加的变化。

en.problem: Can a biomedical agent move beyond a fixed toolbox?
en.method: Accumulates reusable reasoning templates and automatically discovers, creates and integrates tools.

papers.sourceTitle: STELLA: Self-Evolving LLM Agent for Biomedical Research

figures.en: A manager coordinates development, critique and tool creation. Successful reasoning becomes templates, while new tools fill capability gaps.

papers.title: Robin: A multi-agent system for automating scientific discovery
papers.name: Robin

zh.problem: 文献、假设、实验和数据分析怎样形成连续研究循环？
