en.problem: How can literature, hypotheses, experiments and data analysis form a continuous research loop?
en.method: Search and analysis agents propose hypotheses and experiments, then use results to update subsequent research.
en.evaluation: Demonstrated through candidate-treatment research for dry age-related macular degeneration; experimental findings do not establish clinical efficacy.

papers.sourceTitle: Robin: A multi-agent system for automating scientific discovery

zh: 闭环的关键是实验结果真的改变下一轮假设，而不只是生成一份计划。
en: The loop matters when experimental evidence changes the next hypothesis, beyond producing a plan.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 给定疾病目标，系统提出候选并选择实验，再分析实验数据、更新假设。留意哪些步骤由代理完成，哪些实验由实验人员执行。
figures.en: Starting from a disease goal, the system prioritizes candidates, proposes experiments and updates hypotheses from data. Distinguish agent actions from experiments carried out by people.

papers.title: Biomni: A General-Purpose Biomedical AI Agent
papers.name: Biomni

zh.problem: 一个通用智能体怎样跨多个生物医学子领域执行任务？
zh.method: 在统一环境中检索并组合专业工具、软件和数据库，用代码实现研究计划。
zh.evaluation: 论文与官方资料展示多类生物医学任务；工具覆盖面不等于所有任务均可靠完成。

en.problem: How can one general-purpose agent execute tasks across biomedical subfields?
en.method: Retrieves and composes specialized tools, software and databases in a unified environment, implementing research plans through code.
en.evaluation: The paper and official materials demonstrate varied biomedical tasks; broad tool coverage does not imply reliable completion of every task.

papers.sourceTitle: Biomni: A General-Purpose Biomedical AI Agent

zh: 广泛的工具覆盖提供了通用入口；每类任务仍需要独立验证结果。
en: Broad tool coverage offers a general interface, while each task category still needs outcome validation.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 代理先理解问题，再检索工具、软件和数据，编写并执行分析代码。共享环境把多种生物医学能力接到同一个入口。
figures.en: The agent interprets a task, retrieves tools, software and data, then writes and executes analysis code in a shared biomedical environment.

papers.title: TxAgent: An AI Agent for Therapeutic Reasoning Across a Universe of Tools
papers.name: TxAgent

zh.problem: 药物推理如何结合最新资料和患者具体条件？
zh.method: 通过多步工具调用整合药物、相互作用、禁忌和疾病证据，并迭代修订回答。
zh.evaluation: 在五个药物推理基准及个性化情景中评估；这是任务评测，不是临床试验。

en.problem: How can drug reasoning incorporate current evidence and patient-specific conditions?
en.method: Uses multi-step tool calls to combine evidence about drugs, interactions, contraindications and conditions, iteratively revising answers.
en.evaluation: Evaluated on five drug-reasoning benchmarks and personalized scenarios; these are task evaluations, not clinical trials.

papers.sourceTitle: TxAgent: An AI Agent for Therapeutic Reasoning Across a Universe of Tools

institutions: Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard

zh: 药物信息工具能改善证据获取，但问答基准仍不等于临床决策验证。
en: Drug-information tools improve evidence access; question-answering benchmarks are not clinical validation.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 把治疗相关问题分解成可调用工具的步骤，检索药物资料后再推理。重点看回答能否追溯到具体工具结果。
figures.en: Break a therapeutic question into tool-supported steps and retrieve drug information before reasoning. Check whether the answer traces to specific tool outputs.

papers.title: DrugAgent: Automating AI-aided Drug Discovery Programming through LLM Multi-Agent Collaboration
papers.name: DrugAgent

zh.problem: 药物发现中的机器学习思路如何变成领域正确的代码？
zh.method: 规划智能体制定方案，指导智能体补充领域知识并协助实现。
zh.evaluation: 三个药物发现编程案例，包括药物—靶标相互作用预测。

en.problem: How can machine-learning ideas for drug discovery become domain-appropriate code?
en.method: A planner proposes approaches while an instructor supplies domain knowledge and guides implementation.
en.evaluation: Three drug-discovery programming cases, including drug–target interaction prediction.

papers.sourceTitle: DrugAgent: Automating AI-aided Drug Discovery Programming through LLM Multi-Agent Collaboration

zh: 预测分数与有效运行率要一起看，否则高分可能只来自少数成功执行。
en: Read prediction scores together with valid-run rates, since high scores may cover only successful executions.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: Planner 提出建模计划，Instructor 帮助代理掌握所需领域操作，再与环境交互调整实现。
figures.en: The Planner proposes a modeling strategy, the Instructor supplies domain operations, and environment feedback guides implementation changes.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.zh: ROC-AUC 衡量预测区分能力，有效运行率衡量工作流可执行性，两者需要同时报告。
tables.en: ROC-AUC measures predictive discrimination; valid-run rate measures workflow executability. Read both.

papers.title: TourSynbio-Agent: Validation of an LLM-based Multi-Agent Framework for Protein Engineering in Dry Lab and Wet Lab
papers.name: TourSynbio-Agent

zh.problem: 对话式蛋白质工程是否能在计算与湿实验中产生实际效果？
zh.method: 将蛋白质专用语言模型与多个专业预测和设计模型整合到智能体流程。
zh.evaluation: 三个计算案例和两个湿实验案例，包含酶选择性及催化效率优化。

en.problem: Can conversational protein engineering produce useful computational and wet-lab results?
en.method: Integrates a protein-specialized language model with dedicated prediction and design models in an agent workflow.
en.evaluation: Three computational cases and two wet-lab cases, including enzyme selectivity and catalytic-efficiency optimization.

papers.sourceTitle: Validation of an LLM-based Multi-Agent Framework for Protein Engineering in Dry Lab and Wet Lab

zh: 统一工作流降低工具使用门槛，但每个专业模型的适用范围仍然存在。
en: A unified workflow simplifies tool use without removing the limits of its specialized models.

figures.label: Fig. 1
figures.zh: 根据用户的蛋白任务选择专门模型和工具。读图时区分突变预测、结构分析和设计各自需要的输入与输出。
figures.en: Protein tasks are routed to specialized models and tools. Distinguish the inputs and outputs of mutation prediction, structure analysis and design.

papers.title: An AI Agent for Fully Automated Multi-Omic Analyses
papers.name: AutoBA

zh.problem: 生物学研究者如何减少多组学分析中的软件配置与编程？
zh.method: 根据数据路径、数据描述和目标生成分析计划，安装工具、写代码并执行。
zh.evaluation: 评估多种常规组学任务的规划、代码生成和端到端执行；用户仍需提供输入与审查结果。

en.problem: How can biologists reduce software setup and programming in multi-omics analysis?
en.method: Uses a data path, description and goal to plan analyses, install tools, generate code and execute it.
en.evaluation: Evaluates planning, code generation and end-to-end execution across conventional omics tasks; users still supply inputs and review results.

papers.sourceTitle: An AI Agent for Fully Automated Multi-Omic Analyses

institutions: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)

zh: 自动化能减少环境与编程负担，但研究者仍需检查输入数据和分析选择。
en: Automation reduces setup and coding effort; researchers still need to inspect inputs and analytical choices.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 从数据路径、描述和分析目标出发，代理规划步骤、准备软件并执行代码。报错反馈会触发修正。
figures.en: A data path, description and goal drive planning, software preparation and code execution. Error feedback triggers revisions.

papers.title: BioDiscoveryAgent: An AI Agent for Designing Genetic Perturbation Experiments
papers.name: BioDiscoveryAgent

zh.problem: 有限实验预算下，应优先测试哪些基因扰动？
zh.method: 利用生物知识、文献检索和已有实验结果提出下一批候选，并由批评智能体检查。
zh.evaluation: 在六个数据集上比较扰动选择，其中包含未公开数据，并研究组合扰动。

en.problem: Which genetic perturbations should be tested under a limited experimental budget?
en.method: Uses biological knowledge, literature retrieval and earlier results to propose candidates, with critique from another agent.
en.evaluation: Compares perturbation selection across six datasets, including unpublished data, and studies combinatorial perturbations.

papers.sourceTitle: BioDiscoveryAgent: An AI Agent for Designing Genetic Perturbation Experiments

zh: 实验预算有限时，选下一批测试对象的策略本身就是需要评估的科研能力。
en: Under a limited experiment budget, choosing the next candidates is itself a research capability to evaluate.

figures.label: Figure 2
figures.zh: 横轴是实验轮次，纵轴是找到有效基因的比例。比较曲线时也看误差条和每轮测试数量。
figures.en: The x-axis counts experiment rounds; the y-axis measures gene hit ratio. Compare error bars and the number of tests per round alongside the curves.

tables.label: Table 1
tables.zh: 比较相同轮次下找到有效基因的比例；每轮实验数量与重复运行的波动也会影响结论。
tables.en: Compare gene hit ratios at matched rounds, accounting for tests per round and run variability.

papers.title: BioImage.IO Chatbot: a community-driven AI assistant for integrative computational bioimaging
papers.name: BioImage.IO Chatbot

zh.problem: 生物图像分析的文档、模型和工具如何更容易被使用？
zh.method: 结合社区维护的知识来源和工具接口，用自然语言提供有出处的分析帮助。
zh.evaluation: 展示图像分析问答与工具使用场景；依赖知识库内容和工具可用性。

en.problem: How can bioimage-analysis documentation, models and tools become easier to use?
en.method: Combines community-maintained knowledge sources and tool interfaces to provide grounded analysis assistance through natural language.
en.evaluation: Demonstrates image-analysis assistance and tool-use scenarios, depending on knowledge-base coverage and available tools.

papers.sourceTitle: BioImage.IO Chatbot: a community-driven AI assistant for integrative computational bioimaging

institutions: Instituto de Investigación Sanitaria Gregorio Marañón

zh: 更方便的入口有助于使用专业工具，但不会自动保证图像分析选择正确。
en: An accessible interface helps people use specialist tools without guaranteeing the right analysis choices.

figures.label: Fig. 1
figures.zh: 聊天入口连接文档与生物图像分析资源。看用户的问题如何被转换为可执行或可参考的分析建议。
figures.en: A chat interface connects documentation and bioimage-analysis resources. Trace how questions become executable or actionable analysis guidance.

papers.title: TourSynbio: A Multi-Modal Large Model and Agent Framework to Bridge Text and Protein Sequences for Protein Engineering
papers.name: TourSynbio

zh.problem: 如何在一个语言模型中连接自然语言和蛋白质序列？
zh.method: 通过蛋白质与文本数据进行训练，并将专业模型接入统一对话式工程框架。
zh.evaluation: 使用 ProteinLMBench 及蛋白质工程案例，包括两个湿实验示例。

en.problem: How can one language model connect natural language with protein sequences?
en.method: Trains on protein and text data and connects specialized models through a unified conversational engineering framework.
en.evaluation: Uses ProteinLMBench and protein-engineering cases, including two wet-lab examples.

papers.sourceTitle: TourSynbio: A Multi-Modal Large Model and Agent Framework to Bridge Text and Protein Sequences for Protein Engineering

zh: 蛋白序列理解与工具调度是不同能力，需要分别用相应任务验证。
en: Protein-sequence understanding and tool orchestration are distinct capabilities requiring separate evaluation.

figures.label: Fig. 1
figures.zh: 对比传统流程中的外部蛋白编码器与直接读取序列的语言模型。后续代理再根据意图选择专业任务工具。
figures.en: Compare an external protein encoder with a language model that directly processes sequences. An agent then routes intentions to specialized task tools.

tables.label: TABLE II
tables.zh: 这是 ProteinLMBench 的答题正确率，不能替代对真实蛋白设计效果的实验评价。
tables.en: ProteinLMBench accuracy does not replace experimental evaluation of designed proteins.

papers.title: MMedAgent: Learning to Use Medical Tools with Multi-modal Agent
papers.name: MMedAgent

zh.problem: 多模态医学任务如何路由到合适的专业工具？
zh.method: 构造工具使用指令数据，对模型进行微调以学习工具选择与调用。
zh.evaluation: 覆盖六个工具、七项任务和五种模态，并测试加入新工具。

en.problem: How can multimodal medical tasks be routed to appropriate specialized tools?
en.method: Builds tool-use instruction data and fine-tunes a model to select and invoke tools.
en.evaluation: Covers six tools, seven tasks and five modalities, and tests the integration of new tools.

papers.sourceTitle: MMedAgent: Learning to Use Medical Tools with Multi-modal Agent

zh: 选对专用工具可以补足通用多模态模型的短板，但评估应覆盖整个调用链。
en: Specialist tools can complement multimodal models; evaluate the complete tool-use chain.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 多模态输入先被理解，再选择医学工具，处理结果最后用于回答。注意工具输入格式与任务类型是否匹配。
figures.en: Multimodal input leads to medical-tool selection, execution and an answer. Check that the tool's required inputs match the task and modality.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.zh: 表中包含多种医学图像任务，使用的是相对评分；先看各任务再看汇总。
tables.en: These medical-imaging tasks use relative scores; inspect individual tasks before the aggregate.

papers.title: ClinicalAgent: Clinical Trial Multi-Agent System with Large Language Model-based Reasoning
papers.name: ClinicalAgent

zh.problem: 临床试验相关预测怎样利用外部专门工具？
zh.method: 结合多智能体、任务分解和行动反馈，将语言推理连接到临床试验工具。
zh.evaluation: 主要评估临床试验结果预测；预测分数不等于临床效果。

en.problem: How can clinical-trial predictions use specialized external tools?
en.method: Combines multiple agents, task decomposition and action feedback to connect language reasoning with clinical-trial tools.
en.evaluation: Primarily evaluates clinical-trial outcome prediction; prediction scores are not evidence of clinical benefit.

papers.sourceTitle: ClinicalAgent: Clinical Trial Multi-Agent System with Large Language Model-based Reasoning

zh: 分解问题让推理更可检查；最终预测仍需要与真实试验结局比较。
en: Decomposition makes reasoning inspectable; predictions still need comparison with actual trial outcomes.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 把试验结局拆成入组、药物安全和疗效等子问题，再汇总不同专家代理的判断。
figures.en: Trial outcomes are decomposed into enrollment, safety and efficacy questions, then combined from specialist agents' assessments.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.zh: 比较预测指标时，确认相同试验数据与评估划分；相关预测不等于对试验结果的因果解释。
tables.en: Compare predictions on matched trial data and splits; predictive performance is not causal explanation.

papers.title: Empowering Biomedical Discovery with AI Agents
papers.name: Empowering Biomedical Discovery

zh.problem: 生物医学 AI 科学家应怎样与研究者及实验平台协作？
zh.method: 提出结合专业模型、工具、结构化记忆和自我评估的协作研究愿景。
zh.evaluation: 观点文章，讨论虚拟细胞、表型与治疗等方向；不报告统一系统的全面验证。

en.problem: How should biomedical AI scientists collaborate with researchers and experimental platforms?
en.method: Proposes collaborative research systems combining specialized models, tools, structured memory and self-assessment.
en.evaluation: A perspective discussing areas such as virtual cells, phenotypes and therapeutics, without comprehensive validation of a unified system.

papers.sourceTitle: Empowering Biomedical Discovery with AI Agents

institutions: Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard

zh: 这篇文章讨论生物医学代理的组织方式和自主程度，适合用于拆解系统设计。
en: This perspective helps decompose biomedical agent architectures and levels of autonomy.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 不同代理协调模型、工具和实验资源。读图时看人类指导与自动执行的边界，以及反馈怎样改变研究方向。
figures.en: Agents coordinate models, tools and experimental resources. Identify the boundary between human guidance and autonomous action, and how feedback changes research direction.

papers.title: Omega — harnessing the power of large language models for bioimage analysis
papers.name: Omega

zh.problem: 研究者能否在图像查看器里用对话完成图像分析？
zh.method: 作为 napari 插件读取图像与界面状态，生成执行 Python，并根据反馈修正代码。
zh.evaluation: 展示分割、计数、定量和去噪等交互任务。

en.problem: Can researchers perform image analysis conversationally inside an image viewer?
en.method: A napari plugin reads images and viewer state, generates and executes Python, and corrects code using feedback.
en.evaluation: Demonstrates interactive segmentation, counting, quantification and denoising tasks.

papers.sourceTitle: Omega — harnessing the power of large language models for bioimage analysis

zh: 语言接口使图像分析更易用；最终质量仍依赖具体算法与任务设置。
en: Language interfaces improve accessibility; output quality still depends on algorithms and task settings.

figures.label: Fig. 1
figures.zh: 用户用语言提出图像分析任务，系统调用分析能力并反馈结果。先检查输入图像、执行操作和输出是否相互对应。
figures.en: Users describe image-analysis tasks in language and receive results from analysis tools. Check the correspondence between input images, operations and outputs.

papers.title: CellAgent: An LLM-driven Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Single-cell Data Analysis
papers.name: CellAgent

zh.problem: 单细胞分析能否减少人工选工具和调参数的负担？
zh.method: 规划者、执行者和评价者分层协作，迭代检查并优化分析流程。
zh.evaluation: 在覆盖多种组织和细胞类型的单细胞数据上评估。

en.problem: Can single-cell analysis reduce manual tool selection and parameter tuning?
en.method: A planner, executor and evaluator coordinate hierarchically to check and optimize analysis workflows.
en.evaluation: Evaluated on single-cell data spanning multiple tissues and cell types.

papers.sourceTitle: CellAgent: An LLM-driven Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Single-cell Data Analysis

zh: 自动挑选分析方法时，应同时检查技术批次效应与真实生物差异是否被保留。
en: When automating analysis choices, check batch-effect removal alongside preservation of biological variation.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: Planner 分解单细胞分析任务，其他角色执行并评价步骤。关注数据预处理、批次处理和下游解释如何衔接。
figures.en: A Planner decomposes single-cell analysis while other roles execute and evaluate steps. Trace connections between preprocessing, batch handling and downstream interpretation.

papers.title: BioInformatics Agent (BIA): Unleashing the Power of Large Language Models to Reshape Bioinformatics Workflow
papers.name: BioInformatics Agent · BIA

zh.problem: 自然语言能否驱动从数据读取到分析报告的生信工作流？
zh.method: 读取原始数据与元数据、查询数据库、设计工作流、生成代码并总结结果。
zh.evaluation: 以单细胞 RNA 测序为主要案例，并分析执行失败与潜在改进。

en.problem: Can natural language drive a bioinformatics workflow from data access to a report?
en.method: Reads data and metadata, queries databases, designs workflows, generates code and summarizes results.
en.evaluation: Focuses on single-cell RNA sequencing and analyzes execution failures and possible improvements.

papers.sourceTitle: BioInformatics Agent (BIA): Unleashing the Power of Large Language Models to Reshape Bioinformatics Workflow

institutions: Hangzhou Institute of Medicine, Chinese Academy of Sciences
University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

zh: 自动生信流程需要对中间数据与执行日志保持可见，方便发现和纠正错误。
en: Automated bioinformatics needs visible intermediate data and execution logs for error diagnosis.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 把自然语言目标转成数据读取、分析计划、代码执行与总结。失败反馈帮助定位是工具使用问题还是分析选择问题。
figures.en: Natural-language goals become data access, analysis plans, code execution and summaries. Failure feedback helps distinguish tool-use errors from analytical choices.

papers.title: Agent Hospital: A Simulacrum of Hospital with Evolvable Medical Agents
papers.name: Agent Hospital

zh.problem: 模拟诊疗经验能否改善医生智能体的问答表现？
zh.method: 在由患者、护士和医生智能体构成的医院模拟中积累诊疗经验并演化医生策略。
zh.evaluation: 在模拟运行后测试 MedQA；模拟和考试成绩不能替代真实临床验证。

en.problem: Can simulated treatment experience improve a doctor agent's question-answering performance?
en.method: Accumulates experience in a hospital simulation of patient, nurse and doctor agents, evolving the doctor agents' strategies.
en.evaluation: Tests MedQA after simulation; simulated experience and exam scores do not replace real clinical validation.

papers.sourceTitle: Agent Hospital: A Simulacrum of Hospital with Evolvable Medical Agents

zh: 模拟经验可以用于研究学习机制，但模拟中的进步不能直接当成临床成效。
en: Simulated experience supports learning research; simulation gains are not clinical outcomes.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 患者、护士和医生代理在模拟医院里完成就诊循环。医生从模拟经历中积累经验，再到评测任务上检查收益。
figures.en: Patient, nurse and doctor agents complete simulated care cycles. Doctors accumulate experience, with gains assessed on evaluation tasks.

tables.label: Table 4
tables.zh: 这张表测 MedQA 答题表现；模拟医院中的经验迁移到题目，不代表已通过临床验证。
tables.en: This measures MedQA performance, not clinical validation of skills acquired in the simulated hospital.

papers.title: CRISPR-GPT: An LLM Agent for Automated Design of Gene-Editing Experiments
papers.name: CRISPR-GPT

zh.problem: 非专业研究者怎样组织复杂的基因编辑实验设计？
zh.method: 通过领域知识和专业工具支持实验设计中的选择、规划与验证方案整理。
zh.evaluation: 论文展示实际用例；这里提供高层研究解读，具体实验有效性以原论文为准。

en.problem: How can non-specialists organize complex gene-editing experiment design?
en.method: Uses domain knowledge and specialized tools to support choices, planning and validation design within experiments.
en.evaluation: The paper demonstrates a practical use case; these high-level notes defer experimental validity to the original study.

papers.sourceTitle: CRISPR-GPT for Agentic Automation of Gene-editing Experiments

zh: 领域知识和工具能辅助实验设计；方案质量必须由独立的实验结果来检验。
en: Domain knowledge and tools assist experiment design; independent experimental results must establish its quality.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 规划模块把目标拆成设计与验证任务，工具层提供相应能力。图适合用来理解分工，具体实验仍应回到专业验证流程。
figures.en: A planner decomposes goals into design and validation tasks supported by tools. The diagram explains responsibilities; experiments require specialist validation.

papers.title: ProtAgents: Protein discovery via large language model multi-agent collaborations combining physics and machine learning
papers.name: ProtAgents

zh.problem: 蛋白质设计怎样同时调用知识、机器学习和物理模拟？
zh.method: 不同专业智能体动态协作，完成知识检索、结构分析、模拟和结果解释。
zh.evaluation: 展示蛋白质设计与机械性质分析，包括基于物理的振动特性计算。

en.problem: How can protein design combine knowledge, machine learning and physical simulation?
en.method: Specialized agents collaborate dynamically on retrieval, structural analysis, simulation and interpretation.
en.evaluation: Demonstrates protein design and mechanical-property analysis, including physics-based vibrational calculations.

figures.en: Build the social environment and individual states, then let agents perceive information, form attitudes and interact to produce diffusion.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.zh: 这里是个体层面的预测结果；群体传播效果需要看另一组实验。
tables.en: These are individual-level predictions; population diffusion requires separate experiments.

papers.title: The SocialAI school: Insights from developmental psychology towards artificial socio-cultural agents
papers.name: SocialAI School

zh.problem: 人工智能怎样学习参与社会文化所需的认知能力？
zh.method: 根据发展心理学构建可配置、程序生成的社交学习环境。
zh.evaluation: 通过强化学习智能体和语言模型的实验展示环境用途。

en.problem: How can AI learn the cognitive abilities needed to participate in social culture?
en.method: Builds configurable, procedurally generated social-learning environments informed by developmental psychology.
en.evaluation: Demonstrates the environments through experiments with reinforcement-learning agents and language models.

papers.sourceTitle: The SocialAI School: Insights from Developmental Psychology Towards Artificial Socio-Cultural Agents

zh: 可控环境有利于研究能力从哪里来，但仍与开放世界的社交表现有距离。
en: Controlled environments help isolate capabilities while remaining different from open-world social interaction.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 任务环境把社会能力拆成可控制的因素。调整环境设置，可以测试代理是否理解并使用他人的社会线索。
figures.en: Task environments isolate controllable aspects of social ability. Changing their settings tests whether agents understand and use social cues.

tables.label: Table 1
tables.zh: 比较可控社会任务中的成功表现，不能把环境内的成绩等同于开放世界社交能力。
tables.en: Controlled social-task performance does not establish open-world social competence.

papers.title: Understanding the benefits and challenges of using large language model-based conversational agents for mental well-being support
papers.name: Conversational Agents & Mental Well-Being

zh.problem: 使用大模型陪伴应用的人感受到哪些帮助与困难？
zh.method: 对 Replika 相关社区讨论进行定性分析，归纳使用体验与问题。
zh.evaluation: 分析 120 个帖子和 2,917 条评论；这是用户体验研究，不是疗效试验。

en.problem: What benefits and difficulties do users report from language-model companion apps?
en.method: Qualitatively analyzes community discussions about Replika to identify experiences and problems.
en.evaluation: Analyzes 120 posts and 2,917 comments; it is a user-experience study, not an efficacy trial.

papers.sourceTitle: Understanding the Benefits and Challenges of Using Large Language Model-based Conversational Agents for Mental Well-being Support

zh: 用户体验材料同时出现支持感与依赖、内容和记忆等问题；它揭示的是使用体验，不是治疗有效性。
en: User accounts describe both support and problems with dependence, content and memory; these are experiences, not treatment-efficacy evidence.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 这张图展示研究讨论的 Replika 界面。研究证据来自用户社区讨论，而不是对界面的随机实验。
figures.en: This shows the Replika interface discussed in the study. Evidence comes from community accounts, not a randomized test of the interface.

papers.title: Generative agents: Interactive simulacra of human behavior
papers.name: Generative Agents

zh.problem: 智能体如何在虚拟小镇中形成可信的日常和社会行为？
zh.method: 记录经历、检索记忆、形成高层反思，再据此规划行动和互动。
zh.evaluation: 在 25 个智能体的小镇模拟中评估行为可信度，并消融记忆、规划和反思组件。

en.problem: How can agents develop believable daily and social behavior in a virtual town?
en.method: Records experiences, retrieves memories and forms higher-level reflections to plan actions and interactions.
en.evaluation: Evaluates behavioral believability in a 25-agent town and ablates memory, planning and reflection components.

papers.sourceTitle: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior

zh: 可信的模拟行为来自记忆、反思与规划的配合，不能简单等同于真实人类行为模型。
en: Believable simulation emerges from memory, reflection and planning without establishing a general model of human behavior.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 二十五个代理共享一个小镇环境，会记住经历、规划日程并互相交流。图中的故事需要结合记忆与反思机制理解。
figures.en: Twenty-five agents share a town, remember events, plan routines and communicate. Their behavior is explained by the memory and reflection architecture.

papers.title: Large language models as simulated economic agents: What can we learn from homo silicus?
papers.name: Homo Silicus

zh.problem: 语言模型能否作为经济实验中的模拟参与者？
zh.method: 为模型赋予禀赋、信息和偏好，在经典实验情景中观察其选择。
zh.evaluation: 比较模拟与既有经济实验的定性结果，同时讨论使用模拟人的概念限制。

en.problem: Can language models act as simulated participants in economic experiments?
en.method: Assigns endowments, information and preferences to models, then observes choices in established experimental scenarios.
en.evaluation: Compares qualitative outcomes with prior economic experiments and discusses conceptual limits of simulated participants.

papers.sourceTitle: Large Language Models as Simulated Economic Agents: What Can We Learn from Homo Silicus?

zh: 提示设定会改变模拟经济行为，研究结论需要对照真实人类数据。
en: Prompt design changes simulated economic behavior; conclusions need comparison with real human data.

figures.label: Figure 7
figures.zh: 图中讨论 AI 模拟如何帮助形成新命题，也怎样误导研究。把模拟结果当作待检验线索，而不是人类实验的替代品。
figures.en: The diagram considers how AI simulations can help formulate propositions or mislead research. Treat outputs as hypotheses for testing, not replacements for human experiments.

tables.label: Table 1
tables.zh: 这是经典行为实验在 AI 代理上的重现，提示设定与模型选择可能改变结果。
tables.en: This recreates a classic behavioral experiment with AI agents; prompts and model choice can change outcomes.
